source: Hngh… I feel like my head is gonna split in half…
translation: 呃啊……感觉脑袋都快裂成两半了……

source: Oh, Aiden! You’re up!
translation: 哦，Aiden！你醒啦！

source: G-Gah! Not so loud, Yoshi…
translation: 呃——啊！别这么大声，Yoshi……

source: That wasn’t loud at all…
translation: 我根本没多大声啊……

source: Ugh… I’m sorry… I don’t feel so good…
translation: 呃……抱歉……我感觉不太舒服……

source: Here, I ordered some warm soup and got you some aspirin.
translation: 给，我点了些热汤，还给你拿了阿司匹林。

source: Thanks…
translation: 谢了……

source: Looks like you have quite the hangover, huh? You really didn’t hold back on those drinks…
translation: 看来你宿醉得挺厉害啊？昨晚喝酒时真是一点都没收着……

source: Y-Yeah… And from all the stuff laying around, it looks like you’ve been taking care of me, huh…?
translation: 是、是啊……看周围这些东西，昨晚一直是你在照顾我吧……？

source: O-Oh, you mean the empty bucket…? Well… You did puke around two times last night…
translation: 哦、哦，你是说那个空桶……？这个嘛……你昨晚吐了大概两次……

source: Oh crap, I don’t even remember doing that… Sorry, Yoshi…
translation: 糟糕，我完全不记得这事了……抱歉，Yoshi……

source: Haha! It’s alright, Aiden! You’ve cleaned up after my messes plenty of times before!
translation: 哈哈！没事的，Aiden！以前你也帮我收拾过好多次烂摊子！

source: I’m usually the one who gets drunk first after all…
translation: 毕竟平时总是我先喝醉……

source: When I saw you chugging those drinks last night, I decided to slow down to make sure we both didn’t get wasted, haha!
translation: 昨晚看到你一杯接一杯地灌，我就决定少喝点，免得咱俩全都醉倒，哈哈！

source: Yeah… Good call.
translation: 是啊……明智之举。

source: I… can’t even remember exactly how things went down yesterday…
translation: 我……甚至都记不清昨天到底发生了什么……

source: W-Wait, really? You don’t remember anything at all?
translation: 等、等等，真的？你什么都不记得了？

source: Eh… Just a little… Everything’s kind of a blur…
translation: 呃……只记得一点……其他都模模糊糊的……

source: Eh… Just a little… Everything’s kind of a blur… {fast}
translation: 呃……只记得一点……其他都模模糊糊的……{fast}

source: You were a drunken mess.
translation: 你醉得一塌糊涂。

source: You were so drunk you started acting crazy in the club…
translation: 你醉得在夜店里都开始发疯了……

source: Uh-oh, don’t tell me I turned into a puking machine?!
translation: 糟了，别告诉我变成呕吐机器了？！

source: N-No! I-I mean… I don’t know if what you did was worse, but…
translation: 没、没有！我、我是说……我也不知道你做的事是不是更糟，不过……

source: Oh my god, I did what?!
translation: 我的天，我干了什么？！

source: You made a scene.
translation: 你大闹了一场。

source: For starters, you kinda passed out on me…
translation: 首先，你直接在我身上昏过去了……

source: Hehe, was I at least good at it?
translation: 嘿嘿，那我至少跳得还不错吧？

source: *sigh* I should’ve expected you’d ask that…
translation: *叹气* 我早该想到你会这么问……

source: W-Well… How do I put this…?
translation: 这、这个嘛……该怎么说呢……？

source: WHOA! Did we really?!
translation: 哇哦！真的吗？！

source: W-Well… I kinda had to stop myself in the middle before I got too carried away.
translation: 这、这个嘛……我做到一半及时停下了，免得自己彻底失控。

source: The booth we were in wasn’t very private and I was worried someone would catch us…
translation: 我们待的卡座并不怎么隐蔽，我怕会被别人撞见……

source: But I guess I don’t know if that’s any worse than having the entire club watch your strip show…
translation: 不过比起让整个夜店的人看你的脱衣秀，我也不知道哪件事更糟……

source: Even the part when we… did ‘it’?
translation: 连我们……做了“那件事”的部分也不记得？

source: I-It was very real, Aiden…
translation: 那、那可是真真切切发生过的，Aiden……

source: Damn! I scored one with you and I barely even remember, hahaha!
translation: 靠！我好不容易和你做了一次，居然几乎都不记得，哈哈哈！

source: Well, let’s just hope nobody saw us.
translation: 好吧，只希望没人看见我们。

source: Eh? How did that happen?
translation: 诶？怎么会这样？

source: HOLY CRAP! That’s awesome!
translation: 我的天！那也太爽了！

source: *sigh* I knew you’d say something like that…
translation: *叹气* 我就知道你会这么说……

source: Hehe, did they like the show?
translation: 嘿嘿，他们喜欢这场表演吗？

source: They sure did…
translation: 当然喜欢了……

source: Well, Aiden… We kinda did ‘it’… in public…
translation: 这个嘛，Aiden……我们算是在公共场合做了“那件事”……

source: N-No…! I mean, we were in a booth, and things just kind of happened…
translation: 不、不是……！我是说，我们当时在卡座里，然后事情就自然而然地发生了……

source: Even though no one could hear us with the loud music playing, we weren’t really hidden, so I’m pretty sure someone saw us…
translation: 虽然音乐太响，没人听得见我们，但那里并不隐蔽，所以我很确定有人看见了……

source: Hahaha! Your reaction always cracks me up, even after all this time.
translation: 哈哈哈！都过了这么久，你的反应还是每次都能把我逗笑。

source: Even though I’m used to it, you still manage to catch me off guard every time...
translation: 虽然我已经习惯了，你却还是每次都能让我措手不及……

source: After all, when I first got to know you back when I was a scout, I thought you were pretty shy. And oh boy, was I wrong.
translation: 毕竟当年我还是童子军、刚认识你时，还觉得你特别害羞。天啊，我真是大错特错。

source: Well, it’s all thanks to you that I got so comfortable around the camp, you know!
translation: 这个嘛，还不是多亏了你，我才会在营地里这么放得开！

source: I just feel like I don’t have to care about the world whenever I’m with you.
translation: 我只是觉得，只要和你在一起，就不用在乎世俗的眼光。

source: You always understand me and let me enjoy life as it is!
translation: 你总是理解我，也会让我尽情享受生活！

source: Come to think of it, you’ve became more and more unruly as the years went by.
translation: 仔细想想，这些年来你确实越来越不守规矩了。

source: Not that it’s a bad thing, I actually find that really fun about you.
translation: 不过这也不是坏事，我其实很喜欢你这一点。

source: Oh, come on! You were just as bad too!
translation: 拜托！你以前也没好到哪去！

source: Like that one time you snuck out with me during a camping trip to swim and cool off.
translation: 就像那次露营时，你和我偷偷溜出去游泳消暑。

source: Hehe, what can I say? You liked it, so I leaned into it!
translation: 嘿嘿，能怪我吗？你喜欢看，所以我就顺势而为了！

source: Well, you did manage to flash an entire club last night, you know…
translation: 这个嘛，你昨晚确实成功让整个夜店的人都看光了……

source: At Camp Buddy we let it slide, but not here in the city! What if someone had recorded you?
translation: 在伙伴营里我们可以睁一只眼闭一只眼，但城里可不行！万一有人录下来了怎么办？

source: Then I’ll be a star!
translation: 那我就成明星啦！

source: You’re really not bothered by it at all, huh?
translation: 你还真是一点都不在意啊？

source: Hey, if you got the goods, why not show ‘em off?
translation: 嘿，有好货为什么不拿出来炫耀？

source: Hey, if you got the goods, why not show ‘em off? {fast}
translation: 嘿，有好货为什么不拿出来炫耀？{fast}

source: I guess...
translation: 也许吧……

source: I guess that makes sense…
translation: 好像也有道理……

source: That makes sense.
translation: 有道理。

source: You're so confident.
translation: 你真自信。

source: You really are confident, aren’t you?
translation: 你还真是自信，对吧？

source: Well, I worked hard to look like this, after all! Hahaha!
translation: 毕竟我可是很努力才练成这副身材的！哈哈哈！

source: I'd rather not share.
translation: 我不想和别人分享。

source: I’d rather not share you with strangers.
translation: 我可不想让陌生人看到你。

source: Ohoho~ I like a clingy Yoshi!
translation: 哦嚯嚯～我喜欢这么黏人的Yoshi！

source: Anyway, that’s enough worrying about me! Why don’t we go check out some more stuff around the hotel?
translation: 总之，别再担心我了！我们不如再去酒店里四处逛逛？

source: Are you sure? You’re still hungover…
translation: 你确定吗？你还在宿醉……

source: Nah, the soup and the meds fixed me right up!
translation: 没事，热汤和药已经让我满血复活了！

source: Besides, we’re going back to camp tomorrow, right? You don’t wanna spend our last day stuck in our room, do you?
translation: 而且我们明天就要回营地了，对吧？你总不想最后一天还窝在房间里吧？

source: Well, as long as you’re okay!
translation: 好吧，只要你没事就行！

source: So, what do we wanna check out this time?
translation: 那么，这次我们去哪里看看？

source: Let’s see…
translation: 让我想想……

source: How about we check out the lobby?
translation: 去大厅看看怎么样？

source: I guess that’ll kill some time. Sure, why not!
translation: 应该能打发些时间。行啊，为什么不呢！

source: How about we check out the lobby again?
translation: 要不再去大厅看看？

source: You know there’s nothing to see there, Yoshi…
translation: 你知道那里没什么好看的，Yoshi……

source: Well, maybe this time it’ll be different!
translation: 说不定这次会不一样呢！

source: *sigh* Alright.
translation: *叹气* 好吧。

source: Oh, isn’t that Jin over there?
translation: 哦，那边不是Jin吗？

source: Looks like Yuri’s with him too. Let’s go see what they’re up to!
translation: Yuri好像也和他在一起。我们去看看他们在做什么吧！

source: Hey there, you two!
translation: 嗨，你们两个！

source: Oh! Yoshi, Aiden!
translation: 哦！Yoshi、Aiden！

source: Hehe, looks like you finally decided to get out of your room and hang around, huh Jin?
translation: 嘿嘿，看来你终于肯走出房间逛逛了，对吧，Jin？

source: A-Ahehe… Actually, Yuri knocked on my room and dragged me out here…
translation: 啊、啊嘿嘿……其实是Yuri敲了我的房门，硬把我拉出来的……

source: So, what are you both up to?
translation: 所以，你们俩在做什么？

source: Looks like Yuri’s with him too. Let’s see what they’re up to!
translation: Yuri好像也和他在一起。去看看他们在做什么吧！

source: Hey there, you two! Whatcha doin’?
translation: 嗨，你们两个！干什么呢？

source: We wanted to find a nice place to chill, and the seats here are super comfy! Plus, check out the ambience!
translation: 我们想找个舒服的地方放松，这里的座椅超级舒服！而且你看看这气氛！

source: The Wi-Fi signal’s the strongest here, too…
translation: 这里的Wi-Fi信号也是最强的……

source: Let me guess, you two are watching BL on that laptop, aren’t you? Don’t you think that’s something you should be doing in private…?
translation: 让我猜猜，你们俩正在那台笔记本上看BL，对吧？这种事难道不该私下里做吗……？

source: Come on, Yoshi! Just because Jin and I are avid fans of the genre doesn’t mean that’s all we think about!
translation: 拜托，Yoshi！我和Jin是这个类型的忠实粉丝，也不代表我们脑子里只有这个！

source: Somehow I doubt that…
translation: 不知道为什么，我很怀疑……

source: What are you doing then?
translation: 那你们在做什么？

source: Well… It’s kinda confidential…
translation: 这个嘛……有点机密……

source: Hey! We’re really not!
translation: 喂！我们真的没有！

source: Why are you acting so suspicious, then? You two are up to something, aren’t you?
translation: 那你们为什么表现得这么可疑？你们俩肯定在搞什么名堂吧？

source: W-Well… We were actually looking up Ms. Emilia’s profile online…
translation: 这、这个嘛……其实我们在网上查Emilia小姐的个人资料……

source: Emilia…?
translation: Emilia……？

source: J-Jin! That was supposed to be our secret!
translation: J、Jin！这明明是我们的秘密！

source: A-Ah! I-I’m sorry! Is it too late to say we’re watching BL?
translation: 啊、啊！对、对不起！现在改口说我们在看BL还来得及吗？

source: *sigh* I guess we’ve been caught red-handed, then…
translation: *叹气* 看来我们被抓了个正着……

source: Hold on, Yuri. Aren’t you the one who dislikes her the most? Why are you looking her up???
translation: 等等，Yuri。你不是最讨厌她的人吗？为什么还要查她？？？

source: *gasp* Don’t tell me you’re secretly into her?!
translation: *倒吸一口气* 别告诉我你其实暗恋她？！

source: WHAAAAAAT?! NO WAY, AIDEN! TOTALLY THE OPPOSITE!
translation: 什——么？！才不是呢，Aiden！完全相反！

source: *tsk* *tsk* You know you shouldn’t be sticking your nose into other people’s business, Yuri.
translation: *啧* *啧* 你知道不该打探别人的私事，Yuri。

source: D-Don’t worry… It’s actually her public profile we’re looking at… So, we’re not invading her privacy at all…
translation: 别、别担心……我们看的其实是她的公开资料……所以完全不算侵犯隐私……

source: Yeah, what Jin said! This is why we didn’t want to show you, ’cause I knew you’d jump to conclusions!
translation: 没错，Jin说得对！所以我们才不想给你看，因为我早知道你会妄下结论！

source: But why though?
translation: 可为什么呢？

source: Like I’ve been telling you guys, I’ve had a really bad feeling about her from the start!
translation: 就像我一直跟你们说的，从一开始我就觉得她很不对劲！

source: It’s like the old saying, ‘know your enemy!’
translation: 俗话说得好，“知己知彼”！

source: *sigh* Yuri… Emilia’s not our enemy, she’s our co-worker.
translation: *叹气* Yuri……Emilia不是我们的敌人，她是我们的同事。

source: I’m only trying to see if she’s been trash-talking any of us online! Just to make sure she’s really on our side!
translation: 我只是想看看她有没有在网上说我们的坏话！只是想确认她真的和我们一条心！

source: So, you decided to stalk her…?
translation: 所以你决定在网上跟踪她……？

source: Come on, Yoshi! Don’t look at it that way! Looking up people online is super normal, you know!
translation: 拜托，Yoshi！别说得那么难听！在网上查别人是很正常的事！

source: But you’re doing it to find something she did wrong… And you’re dragging Jin into this too…
translation: 但你是为了找她的错处……还把Jin也拖下水了……

source: Hmph! You don’t get it, Yoshi! She’s bossy and mean at work, and she has the nerve to throw shade at me every chance she gets!
translation: 哼！你不懂，Yoshi！她工作时又专横又刻薄，而且一有机会就含沙射影地挖苦我！

source: When I ran into her yesterday, she tried to call me cheap and tacky!
translation: 昨天碰见她时，她还拐弯抹角地说我廉价又俗气！

source: She said that to you…?
translation: 她真这么说你……？

source: She might as well have, saying that my taste in fashion hasn’t changed after all these years!
translation: 她说这么多年过去了，我的时尚品味还是一点没变，这和直接骂我有什么区别！

source: Just because I don’t wear designer brands like her doesn’t make that true, you know?!
translation: 我只是不像她那样穿设计师品牌，又不代表她说得对？！

source: Like I get it! You’re rich! Stop shoving it in my face!
translation: 行了，我知道你有钱！别老在我面前炫耀！

source: You know that’s how she’s always been, Yuri… Who knows? Maybe she’s just trying to start a conversation with you.
translation: 你知道她向来就是这样，Yuri……谁知道呢？也许她只是想找你搭话。

source: If ‘starting a conversation’ means being a rude and condescending bitch, then no thanks!
translation: 如果“搭话”就是像个傲慢无礼的臭婊子，那还是免了吧！

source: Not knowing how to socialize doesn’t give her a pass to be a bitch!
translation: 不懂社交也不能成为她当婊子的借口！

source: Sheesh, Yuri… Even after all these years, you still hate her this much?
translation: 天啊，Yuri……这么多年过去了，你还是这么讨厌她？

source: Hmph! Why shouldn’t I? She and I never got along in the first place!
translation: 哼！我为什么不能讨厌她？我们从一开始就合不来！

source: I’m really curious as to why… Maybe you two just got off on the wrong foot?
translation: 我真的很好奇原因……也许你们只是开头没相处好？

source: Don’t get me wrong, Jin. I tried to be friends with her, and I gave her lots of chances back then!
translation: 别误会，Jin。我以前试过和她做朋友，也给过她很多次机会！

source: But it never worked because we were never on the same wavelength!
translation: 可从来都没成功，因为我们根本不在一个频道上！

source: She used to act as if I was her rival or something when I was just minding my own business!
translation: 我明明只是在做自己的事，她以前却总把我当成什么竞争对手！

source: We even fought when no one could see us…
translation: 我们甚至还趁没人看见时打过架……

source: Whoa… like an actual physical fight?
translation: 哇……真动手打的那种？

source: *sigh* I remember that… One time it got really bad and they got caught by Sir Goro…
translation: *叹气* 我记得……有一次闹得特别严重，还被Goro先生撞见了……

source: And it was about something so pointless, too! Ugh, I’ll never forget that one either…
translation: 而且起因还是一件特别无聊的小事！呃，我也永远忘不了那次……

source: Give it back, Emilia! That’s not yours!
translation: 还给我，Emilia！那不是你的！

source: Gadgets aren’t allowed at camp! How come that rule doesn’t apply to you?!
translation: 营地不准带电子设备！凭什么这条规定对你不适用？！

source: Oh, I KNOW! It’s because you’re the owner’s daughter! Talk about rampant nepotism! This camp is absolutely ridiculous!!!
translation: 哦，我知道了！因为你是营地主人的女儿！这裙带关系也太明目张胆了！这个营地简直荒唐透顶！！！

source: What does that have to do with my camera, Emilia?! I’m not doing any harm, and it’s not distracting anyone!
translation: 这和我的相机有什么关系，Emilia？！我又没害人，也没影响任何人！

source: It’s not just about this stupid camera! You get away with EVERYTHING!
translation: 这不只是这台破相机的事！你做什么都能得到特殊待遇！

source: You get to skip activities whenever you want, bring your books on camping trips, and they even let you stay with everyone in the boys’ cabins!!
translation: 你想不参加活动就不参加，露营还能带书，甚至还能和大家一起住男生小屋！！

source: If you can get your demands fulfilled on a whim, then why can’t I as well?!
translation: 如果你随口提的要求都能得到满足，那我为什么不行？！

source: I don’t want this ugly uniform, I want my own designer wardrobe!
translation: 我不要这套丑制服，我要穿自己的设计师品牌衣服！

source: I’m sick and tired of being fed commoner’s grub every meal! I want my personal chef!
translation: 我受够了每顿都吃这种平民饭菜！我要我的私人厨师！

source: And last but not the least, I don’t want to share a room with girls who keep gossiping about me just because they’re jealous!
translation: 最后，我不想和那些因为嫉妒就不停说我闲话的女生住在同一个房间！

source: Is that too much to ask?!
translation: 这要求很过分吗？！

source: You’re being such a SPOILED BRAT! Just give me my camera back!!
translation: 你就是个被宠坏的熊孩子！快把相机还给我！！

source: Not until you tell your dad to give me everything I just said!
translation: 除非你让你爸把我刚才说的东西全都给我！

source: Go ask him yourself! I’m not your servant!
translation: 你自己去找他要！我又不是你的佣人！

source: It’s not my fault that you look like one!
translation: 你长得就像佣人，这可不是我的错！

source: I can’t stand you! You’re so whiney and entitled! Why are you even at this camp?!
translation: 我受不了你！又爱抱怨又自以为是！你到底为什么要来这个营地？！

source: Shouldn’t pompous, rich snobs like you be rotting in your mansion all alone?!
translation: 像你这种自命不凡的有钱势利鬼，不该独自在豪宅里烂掉吗？！

source: Your parents probably don’t even have the time for you, that’s why you have such a nasty attitude!
translation: 你爸妈大概根本没时间陪你，所以你性格才这么恶劣！

source: Sh-Shut up! My parents love me! They buy me EVERYTHING I ask for!
translation: 闭、闭嘴！我爸妈爱我！我想要什么他们都会买给我！

source: Apparently, they forgot to buy you a GOOD PERSONALITY, too!
translation: 看来他们唯独忘了给你买个好性格！

source: Just accept the fact that you’re stuck here because they don’t wanna deal with a spoiled brat like you!
translation: 认清现实吧，你被扔在这里，就是因为他们不想应付你这种被宠坏的孩子！

source: I—
They threw you away, crossing their fingers that you’d change, and learn how to get along with other people.
translation: 他们把你丢到这里，只能祈祷你会有所改变，学会怎么和别人相处。

source: But too bad nobody wants to be friends with you because you’re such a BITCH!!!
translation: 可惜没人愿意和你做朋友，因为你就是个臭婊子！！！

source: I’m a WHAT?! Take that back!!!
translation: 你说我是什、什么？！把话收回去！！！

source: Did I stutter? I said, You’re. A. BITCH.
translation: 我结巴了吗？我说，你、是、个、婊、子。

source: EURGH! How dare you?!
translation: 呃啊！你怎么敢？！

source: *throws Yuri’s camera on the ground*
translation: *把Yuri的相机摔在地上*

source: M-My camera…!!
translation: 我、我的相机……！！

source: *tramples the camera*
translation: *用脚踩相机*

source: Nobody calls me a bitch!!! Take that!!
translation: 没人能骂我是婊子！！！看招！！

source: Stop!! You’re breaking it!!!
translation: 住手！！你要把它踩坏了！！！

source: Just ask daddy for a new one~! Oh wait, you’re too poor to afford another!
translation: 让你爸爸再买一台嘛～！哦，等等，你家穷得买不起新的！

source: Do you have any idea how much that camera means to me?! My dad gave it to me for my birthday!!!
translation: 你知道那台相机对我有多重要吗？！那是我爸爸送我的生日礼物！！！

source: Owww!! You’re ruining my hair!!! I spent all morning styling this!!
translation: 好痛！！你把我的头发弄乱了！！！我花了一早上才做好这个造型！！

source: No one cares about your freaking hair! You ugly, conceited-ass bitch!!
translation: 没人关心你那该死的头发！你这个又丑又自恋的臭婊子！！

source: I told you, stop calling me a bitch!!!
translation: 我说了，不许再叫我婊子！！！

source: That’s what you are!
translation: 你本来就是！

source: Fight! Fight! Fight!
translation: 打！打！打！

source: Wh-What’s going on here?!
translation: 这、这是怎么回事？！

source: YURI!
translation: Yuri！

source: Yuri, that’s enough! Let her go!
translation: Yuri，够了！放开她！

source: *sobs* Look what she did to my hair! Thanks for saving me from this bully, Yoshi!
translation: *抽泣* 看看她把我的头发弄成什么样了！谢谢你从这个恶霸手里救了我，Yoshi！

source: She… just… attacked me out of nowhere!
translation: 她……突然……莫名其妙就袭击我！

source: What?! Nowhere?! You threw my camera on the ground, you lying bitch!!
translation: 什么？！莫名其妙？！明明是你把我的相机摔在地上，你这个满口谎话的婊子！！

source: Yuri! Language!
translation: Yuri！注意用词！

source: I’m telling the truth! She really—
translation: 我说的是真的！她真的——

source: She’s the one who pulled my hair first! I was just defending myself!
translation: 是她先扯我头发的！我只是在自卫！

source: Yuri! You should know that violence is never the answer!!
translation: Yuri！你应该知道暴力永远解决不了问题！！

source: B-But, Dad!!
translation: 可、可是，爸爸！！

source: She should be punished for this! You can’t let this slide just because she’s your daughter!!
translation: 她必须为此受罚！你不能因为她是你女儿就放过她！！

source: Time out, you two!!
translation: 你们两个都给我停下！！

source: Yuri, in my office!
translation: Yuri，去我办公室！

source: NOW!
translation: 现在就去！

source: UGH!!!
translation: 呃啊！！！

source: Ms. Komarova, we’ll discuss this matter later. Yoshinori, please take her to the infirmary and check for any injuries.
translation: Komarova小姐，这件事我们稍后再谈。Yoshinori，请带她去医务室检查有没有受伤。

source: Y-Yes, sir…!
translation: 是、是，先生……！

source: As for the rest of you! Go back to your cabins! There’s nothing to see here!
translation: 至于其他人！都回自己的小屋去！这里没什么好看的！

source: Whew… That sounds… really intense…
translation: 呼……听起来……真够激烈的……

source: Ahehe, kinda feel like I missed out on that show…
translation: 啊嘿嘿，感觉错过了一场好戏……

source: I’m a lot stronger than I look~ She never tried to get anywhere near me after that incident.
translation: 我的力气可比看起来大得多～从那以后，她再也不敢靠近我了。

source: *sigh* I know it’s hard to believe but Yuri was quite the troublemaker back then.
translation: *叹气* 我知道很难相信，不过Yuri当年确实很会惹麻烦。

source: Heeeeeyyy! Don’t just slander me like that in front of Jin!
translation: 喂——！别当着Jin的面这样诋毁我！

source: Oh wow… I was sure you were a model scout like Yoshi…
translation: 哇哦……我还以为你和Yoshi一样，是个模范童子军……

source: Not when someone like Emilia tests me! That time should’ve taught her a lesson not to mess with my stuff!
translation: 碰上Emilia那种挑战我底线的人就不是了！那次应该已经让她明白，不能乱碰我的东西！

source: So, when’s the rematch? She’s been getting on your nerves again, so…
translation: 所以什么时候再打一场？她最近又惹你生气了，那么……

source: Aiden… Don’t encourage her…
translation: Aiden……别怂恿她……

source: Hmph! We’re already professionals, I’m not going to be childish and spiteful like her!
translation: 哼！我们已经是专业人士了，我才不会像她那样幼稚又记仇！

source: Oh! I just found her Instaglam!
translation: 哦！我刚找到她的Instaglam了！

source: WHERE?! Lemme see!
translation: 在哪儿？！快给我看看！

source: So much for being professionals…
translation: 还说什么专业人士呢……

source: Ugh! Elitist as always! Posting pictures of designer stuff and random things in the hotel!
translation: 呃！还是一如既往地摆精英架子！净发些设计师品牌和酒店里乱七八糟东西的照片！

source: It looks like she hasn’t posted anything before this too. Let me see if she linked her Fakebook and Twatter here too…
translation: 看起来她之前也没发过任何东西。我看看她有没有在这里链接Fakebook和Twatter账号……

source: Haha, yeah! Do that!
translation: 哈哈，对！快找！

source: *sigh* Maybe it’s best to leave them to their business.
translation: *叹气* 也许最好别管她们了。

source: Yeah, they look like they’re having harmless fun, anyways.
translation: 是啊，反正她们看起来也只是闹着玩，没什么危害。

source: Alright, let’s go somewhere else!
translation: 好了，我们去别的地方吧！

source: {i}Eventually, we decided to head back to our room for the night.{/i}
translation: {i}最后，我们决定回房间过夜。{/i}

source: Wanna go check out the club again? I’m curious what’s there during the day.
translation: 想再去夜店看看吗？我很好奇那里白天是什么样。

source: Whoa, whoa, whoa, you’re not planning to get me drunk again, are you?
translation: 哇，等等等等，你该不会又打算把我灌醉吧？

source: Haha, don’t worry! We’ll just go there to chill this time.
translation: 哈哈，放心！这次我们只是去放松一下。

source: Ah! I thought you two might end up here at some point today.
translation: 啊！我就想你们俩今天迟早会来这里。

source: Here, come sit with me.
translation: 来，坐到我这边。

source: Hehe, doin’ some good ol’ day drinking, Gramps?
translation: 嘿嘿，大白天就喝上了啊，Gramps？

source: Haha! I thought it might be a nice way to warm me up. The weather’s gotten much colder over the last few days.
translation: 哈哈！我想这样正好能暖暖身子。这几天天气冷了不少。

source: Besides, I was so relaxed at the spa that I lost track of time and then ended up spending the whole day there yesterday.
translation: 而且昨天我在水疗中心太放松，忘了时间，结果一整天都待在那里。

source: We actually checked this place out last night… It was much livelier then!
translation: 其实我们昨晚来过这里……当时可热闹多了！

source: There were a lot more people, loud music, and... uh… entertainers.
translation: 当时人多得多，音乐也很响，还有……呃……表演人员。

source: That makes sense. High-end bars like these tend to have nightlife activities.
translation: 这很正常。这种高档酒吧通常都会有夜间活动。

source: I personally prefer a cozier and calmer ambience when I’m having my drinks.
translation: 就我个人而言，喝酒时更喜欢舒适安静的氛围。

source: Yeah, I can barely recognize this place compared to how crazy it was here last night!
translation: 是啊，和昨晚疯狂的样子相比，我都快认不出这里了！

source: I gotta say, I had tons of fun with that whole ‘clubbing’ thing last night! I could get used to it!
translation: 不得不说，昨晚那种“泡夜店”的体验太好玩了！我能习惯这种生活！

source: Yeah, you did. A lot more than you were supposed to…
translation: 是啊，你确实玩得很开心。开心得过头了……

source: Well, Aiden does strike me as someone who’d enjoy a place like this. Maybe not as much for you, Yoshinori.
translation: Aiden看起来确实会喜欢这种地方。至于你可能就没那么喜欢了，Yoshinori。

source: I was trying to moderate our drinks, but I still lost count in the end…
translation: 我本来想控制一下我们喝的量，可最后还是数不清了……

source: Yeah, I was super wasted!
translation: 是啊，我当时醉得不省人事！

source: Those cocktails really hit the spot! I can’t remember how many I had!
translation: 那些鸡尾酒真带劲！我都不记得喝了多少杯！

source: What did you guys have?
translation: 你们都喝了些什么？

source: I don’t actually remember… The bartender mixed something up for us, I forgot to ask what it was called.
translation: 其实我不记得了……酒保给我们调了点东西，我忘记问叫什么。

source: Hahaha, Yoshi and I looked like headless chickens, not knowing what to order!
translation: 哈哈哈，我和Yoshi像无头苍蝇一样，完全不知道该点什么！

source: You usually order stuff for us whenever we have a drink out, Sir Goro.
translation: 平时我们出去喝酒，都是Goro先生替我们点单。

source: But then again, we always just get beer.
translation: 不过话说回来，我们每次也只喝啤酒。

source: Well, it’s a good thing the bartender here knows their job. Especially if you guys managed to get drunk, hehe.
translation: 幸好这里的酒保很专业。尤其是既然能把你们俩都灌醉，呵呵。

source: Hey! Speak for yourself, Gramps! Look at you with all these empty glasses lying around.
translation: 喂！先说说你自己吧，Gramps！看看你周围摆了多少空杯子。

source: Hehehe~ Spilling the beans in front of Gramps, Yoshi?
translation: 嘿嘿嘿～Yoshi，你要当着Gramps的面把秘密都抖出来吗？

source: *sigh* I knew you were gonna react to that.
translation: *叹气* 我就知道你会有这种反应。

source: Ah, yes, of course. Very fitting for youngsters like you.
translation: 啊，是啊，当然。很适合你们这样的年轻人。

source: Either way, I’m glad you two had a great time last night. The bartender here’s really good at their job.
translation: 不管怎样，很高兴你们昨晚玩得很开心。这里的酒保确实很专业。

source: You do seem like you’ve been drinking for a while with all these empty glasses lying around, sir.
translation: 先生，看周围这些空杯子，您好像已经喝了很久。

source: *ehem* The way you phrased that…
translation: *咳咳* 你这说法听起来……

source: Well, I thought I’d take advantage of this rare opportunity and try out some options I’ve never had before.
translation: 我只是想趁这个难得的机会，试试以前没喝过的选择。

source: But even after all this, I still prefer a vintage scotch on the rocks.
translation: 不过尝过这么多之后，我还是更喜欢加冰的陈年苏格兰威士忌。

source: Heh! I’m not like you, kiddo. With all my experience, I have a pretty high tolerance.
translation: 哼！我可不像你，小子。凭我多年的经验，酒量可是很好的。

source: Except for that one time!
translation: 除了那一次！

source: If Yoshi’s a sappy drunk, and I’m a wild drunk, then you’re a mopey drunk, Gramps!
translation: 如果Yoshi醉了会多愁善感，我醉了会撒野，那Gramps你醉了就会垂头丧气！

source: What? I don’t remember you seeing that.
translation: 什么？我不记得你见过我那样。

source: S-Sir, I think he’s talking about a different time…
translation: 先、先生，我想他说的是另外一次……

source: Yoshi?
translation: Yoshi？

source: Can’t sleep?
translation: 睡不着吗？

source: Yeah… I’m just stretching a bit and watching the stars before bed.
translation: 是啊……睡前出来伸展一下，看看星星。

source: O-Oh hey, is that… Yuri?
translation: 哦、哦，等等，那是……Yuri吗？

source: Huh? What is she doing over there?
translation: 嗯？她在那里做什么？

source: Hey, Yuri!
translation: 嘿，Yuri！

source: You guys startled me!
translation: 你们吓我一跳！

source: What are you doing up so late?
translation: 这么晚了你在做什么？

source: I should be asking you that! You’re the one who always makes us go to sleep on time!
translation: 这话应该我问你才对！平时总催我们按时睡觉的人可是你！

source: ha! You two must’ve been trying to sneak away for some midnight action, huh?!
translation: 哈！你们两个一定是想偷偷溜出去，半夜干点刺激的事，对吧？！

source: N-No, Yuri. Aiden just happened to catch me out here while I was getting some fresh air.
translation: 不、不是，Yuri。我只是出来透透气，正好碰见了Aiden。

source: But you still didn’t answer my question! Why are you out here?
translation: 可你还没回答我的问题！你为什么在这里？

source: And why do you have a bag of stuff?
translation: 而且为什么还带着一袋东西？

source: *gasp* Are you running away from home?!
translation: *倒吸一口气* 你要离家出走吗？！

source: Don’t be silly, Aiden. It’s nothing like that! I’m just getting away from Dad for a little while.
translation: 别傻了，Aiden。才不是那么回事！我只是想暂时躲开爸爸。

source: Eh? Why? Did you guys have a fight?
translation: 诶？为什么？你们吵架了？

source: N-Not really. It’s just… He’s been drinking a lot more lately and tonight he’s hit the jackpot.
translation: 也、也不算。只是……他最近喝得越来越多，今晚更是醉得登峰造极。

source: I really hate seeing him whenever he’s drunk like this.
translation: 我真的很讨厌看到他醉成这个样子。

source: Is it really okay to leave him alone like that, though? Should we check on him to be sure?
translation: 不过把他一个人留在那里真的没问题吗？我们要不要去确认一下？

source: Trust me, you don’t wanna see it. He acts like a completely different person!
translation: 相信我，你们绝对不会想看的。他会变得像另一个人一样！

source: He’s all weird and cringey, nothing like what you guys see when he’s at work as our scoutmaster!
translation: 整个人又古怪又尴尬，和平时担任童子军长时的样子完全不同！

source: Oh boy! We gotta see this, Yoshi!
translation: 天啊！我们一定得去看看，Yoshi！

source: G-Good idea, Aiden! Maybe Sir Goro needs help or something…!
translation: 好、好主意，Aiden！说不定Goro先生需要帮忙什么的……！

source: Hmph, that excuse is as fake as it gets, Yoshi. You just wanna see too.
translation: 哼，这借口假得不能再假了，Yoshi。你也只是想看而已。

source: I promise, just a quick peek…!
translation: 我保证，就偷偷看一眼……！

source: If you guys want to see him so bad, you can from the window. But don’t say I didn’t warn you!
translation: 既然你们这么想看，就从窗户看吧。不过别说我没警告过你们！

source: First!
translation: 我先来！

source: H-Hey! Wait for me!
translation: 喂、喂！等等我！

source: There he is!
translation: 他在那里！

source: Ssh! Keep it down!
translation: 嘘！小声点！

source: O-Oh! Sir Goro’s saying something…!
translation: 哦、哦！Goro先生在说什么……！

source: Ahhh… It’s just you and me, now…
translation: 啊……现在只剩你和我了……

source: You’re the only one who listens to all my problems, you know?
translation: 你知道吗？只有你愿意听我诉说所有烦恼。

source: Is he… talking to that bottle…?
translation: 他是在……和那个瓶子说话吗……？

source: It looks like it…
translation: 看起来是的……

source: I know I’m not the same guy I used to be, but I’m really trying my best… for us…
translation: 我知道自己已经不是从前的那个人了，但我真的在尽最大努力……为了我们……

source: We’ve come so far after all these years… Please don’t ever leave us…
translation: 这么多年我们一路走到现在……请你永远不要离开我们……

source: You won’t leave me right…? Right?
translation: 你不会离开我的，对吧……？对吧？

source: Please answer me… The silence is deafening… Hello???
translation: 求你回答我……这沉默震耳欲聋……喂？？？

source: Pfft…! Is this for real?!
translation: 噗……！这是真的吗？！

source: A-Aiden, ssh…!!
translation: 艾、Aiden，嘘……！！

source: W-What’s that…? You’re saying yes…?
translation: 什、什么……？你答应了……？

source: I knew you’d change your mind…! Now come here and give me a kiss!
translation: 我就知道你会改变主意……！现在过来亲我一下！

source: *gulp* *gulp* *gulp*
translation: *咕咚* *咕咚* *咕咚*

source: Ugh… This is so embarrassing…
translation: 呃……太丢人了……

source: Ahhh… I love you bottle… I love you too, couch…
translation: 啊……我爱你，酒瓶……我也爱你，沙发……

source: *burp*
translation: *打嗝*

source: Oh crap! He just died!
translation: 糟了！他刚刚死了！

source: WAH! Should we call an ambulance or something?!
translation: 哇啊！我们是不是该叫救护车？！

source: HAHAHAHA!!! Calm down, Yoshi! He just passed out!
translation: 哈哈哈哈哈！！！冷静点，Yoshi！他只是昏睡过去了！

source: Th-This isn’t something to laugh about, Aiden…!!
translation: 这、这可不是什么好笑的事，Aiden……！！

source: HAHAHA! How can I not?! Did you see how he made out with that bottle?!
translation: 哈哈哈！怎么可能不好笑？！你看到他刚才和那个酒瓶亲得多热烈了吗？！

source: Y-Yuri, how are you so calm about this?!
translation: 尤、Yuri，你怎么还能这么冷静？！

source: *sigh* Dad’s fine, Yoshi. It happens all the time.
translation: *叹气* 爸爸没事，Yoshi。这种事经常发生。

source: Even the part when he started straddling the pillow? HAHAHA!
translation: 包括他骑到枕头上的那部分？哈哈哈！

source: Yup! There’s also that one gross time he was sobbing about giving me a little brother to fix the problems.
translation: 没错！还有一次更恶心，他一边哭，一边说要给我生个弟弟来解决问题。

source: Can’t unsee the stuff he tried to do to my poor stuffed panda…
translation: 他对我可怜的熊猫玩偶做的那些事，我这辈子都忘不掉……

source: P-Pfftt…!!
Oh my god! HAHAHAHA! You should’ve taken pictures!
translation: 我的天！哈哈哈哈！你当时应该拍照的！

source: Hehe, I definitely have! I can show you guys tomorrow!
translation: 嘿嘿，我当然拍了！明天可以给你们看！

source: Ooh, ooh, I wanna see!
translation: 哦哦，我要看！

source: Y-You guys can’t do that!
translation: 你、你们不能这么做！

source: Oh, come on, Yoshi. I know you want to see them too~
translation: 拜托，Yoshi。我知道你也想看～

source: Besides, I’m gonna show them to Dad someday to make him stop drinking!
translation: 而且总有一天我要拿给爸爸看，让他戒酒！

source: Does Sir Goro drink this much usually…?
translation: Goro先生平时也喝这么多吗……？

source: Only when he has problems! That’s why I hate it so much!
translation: 只有遇到烦心事时才会！所以我才特别讨厌！

source: He never opens up to me unless he’s drunk. And when he’s this drunk, he becomes a total crybaby and can’t even hold a real conversation.
translation: 除非喝醉，否则他从不对我敞开心扉。可醉到这种程度，他就会变成爱哭鬼，连正常对话都做不到。

source: But the stuff he was saying… It sounded like it’s a big deal.
translation: 但他刚才说的那些话……听起来像是出了什么大事。

source: Yoshi, he’s talking to furniture.
translation: Yoshi，他在和家具说话。

source: Don’t forget humping.
translation: 别忘了还骑在上面乱蹭。

source: HAHAHA!
translation: 哈哈哈！

source: Come on, you two…
translation: 拜托，你们两个……

source: I told you, he’s gonna be fine, Yoshi. He’ll be back to normal tomorrow morning like nothing happened.
translation: 我说过了，他不会有事的，Yoshi。明早就会恢复正常，像什么都没发生过一样。

source: I don’t know how, but as soon as he gears up in his camp uniform, he’s enthusiastic and happy all of a sudden.
translation: 我也不知道为什么，只要穿上营地制服，他就会突然变得热情又开心。

source: Hahaha, totally the opposite of the snot-covered face we just saw!
translation: 哈哈哈，和我们刚才看到那张涕泪横流的脸完全相反！

source: *sigh* He’s still our scoutmaster, Aiden.
translation: *叹气* 他毕竟还是我们的童子军长，Aiden。

source: Anyway, can I bunk with you guys for the night? Usually this goes on for hours and I can’t sleep with all the groaning and sobbing.
translation: 总之，我今晚能和你们住吗？这种情况通常会持续几个小时，他一直呻吟抽泣，我根本睡不着。

source: It’s fine, but… Are you sure we can leave your dad like that?
translation: 当然可以，不过……真能把你爸爸就这样留在那里吗？

source: Yeah, yeah, it’s fine! How many times do I have to tell you?
translation: 可以可以，没问题！到底要我说多少次？

source: Now, I’ll go take that top bunk!
translation: 好了，上铺归我了！

source: H-Hey, that’s my spot…!
translation: 喂、喂，那是我的位置……！

source: Go share a bed with Aiden! Hihihi~
translation: 去和Aiden挤一张床吧！嘻嘻嘻～

source: Damn it… I can’t believe you two saw me like that…
translation: 该死……真不敢相信你们两个看见了我那副样子……

source: That was supposed to be a secret, Aiden…
translation: 那本来应该是个秘密，Aiden……

source: Over all these years, I thought I kept up the reliable and responsible scoutmaster image, but you both witnessed such an embarrassing moment…
translation: 这么多年来，我一直以为自己维持住了可靠负责的童子军长形象，结果你们俩却目睹了那么丢人的一幕……

source: Yup, Gramps~! That’s why no matter how tough you act around us, we know you’re a softie~!
translation: 没错，Gramps～！所以无论你在我们面前装得多强硬，我们都知道你其实是个软心肠～！

source: S-SOFTIE?!
translation: 软、软心肠？！

source: You better take it easy with those shots, alright? Don’t want you turning into a crying mess so early in the morning!
translation: 这些子弹酒你最好悠着点，好吗？我可不想一大早就看到你哭得一塌糊涂！

source: Oh? Says the boy who can’t keep his clothes on when he’s drunk?
translation: 哦？这话居然是那个喝醉就穿不住衣服的小子说的？

source: Now, now, you two…
translation: 好了好了，你们两个……

source: Let’s put it to the test then – whoever drinks the most shots wins!
translation: 那就比比看吧——谁喝的子弹酒最多谁就赢！

source: H-Hold on, Aiden! You’re still hungover, I thought we weren’t gonna—
translation: 等、等等，Aiden！你还在宿醉，我以为我们不会再——

source: A-Ack! Don’t get carried away, sir…! We’re all gonna get kicked out if Aiden—
translation: 啊、啊！别太冲动，先生……！要是Aiden真那么做，我们都会被赶出去——

source: DEAL!  Ohohoho, put your ugly-crying face on, ’cause I’m the obvious winner when it comes to booze, Gramps!
translation: 成交！哦嚯嚯嚯，准备摆出你那张难看的哭脸吧，因为比喝酒显然是我赢，Gramps！

source: *takes a shot*
translation: *喝下一杯子弹酒*

source: AHH!
translation: 啊哈！

source: Heh! I didn’t even feel a thing!
translation: 哼！我一点感觉都没有！

source: This is gonna be a long day…
translation: 今天可有得熬了……

source: {i}Sir Goro and Aiden had gotten really fired up for their sudden drinking competition…{/i}
translation: {i}Goro先生和Aiden突然为这场饮酒比赛燃起了斗志……{/i}

source: {i}After they’d had a few drinks, I stepped in and stopped them from getting totally wasted before it was even evening.{/i}
translation: {i}他们喝了几杯后，我出面阻止了他们，免得还没到晚上就彻底醉倒。{/i}

source: {i}They both grudgingly agreed to stop but promised to settle it when we got back to camp.  {/i}
translation: {i}两人不情不愿地答应停下，却约好回营地后再分胜负。{/i}

source: {i}Eventually, we decided to get out and explore another area of the hotel.{/i}
translation: {i}最后，我们决定离开这里，去探索酒店的其他区域。{/i}

source: {i}After they’d had a few drinks, I stepped in and stopped them from getting totally wasted before dark.{/i}
translation: {i}他们喝了几杯后，我出面阻止了他们，免得天黑前就彻底醉倒。{/i}

source: Maybe it’d be nice to relax a little bit, so how about we try the spa?
translation: 也许稍微放松一下会很好，我们去水疗中心怎么样？

source: How about we take a dip at the bathhouse again?
translation: 我们再去浴场泡一泡怎么样？

source: Ooh, good idea! That’ll help me with my hangover!
translation: 哦，好主意！这样能缓解我的宿醉！

source: Fwahhh… This is great! I can already feel my headache melting away!
translation: 呼哇……太舒服了！我已经感觉头痛在慢慢消失！

source: The water is so nice and warm… Perfect for how cold it’s been getting lately…
translation: 水又暖又舒服……正适合最近越来越冷的天气……

source: Ughhh! I can barely walk!!
translation: 呃啊！我都快走不动了！！

source: Huh? That voice sounds familiar.
translation: 嗯？这个声音听起来很耳熟。

source: This wouldn’t have happened if you weren’t so rough last night, you know?
translation: 你昨晚要是没那么粗暴，就不会变成这样了，知道吗？

source: I’ll carry you.
translation: 我抱你。

source: Wh-What? No! Everyone’s gonna look at us again!
translation: 什、什么？不要！大家又会盯着我们看的！

source: Hey, guys! Over here!
translation: 嘿，各位！这边！

source: Oh. Aiden. Yoshi.
translation: 哦。Aiden。Yoshi。

source: It’s nice seeing you two here, Lloyd, Darius.
translation: 很高兴在这里见到你们，Lloyd、Darius。

source: Hiiii~! I’m so excited we get to check out the spa today! We didn’t get to yesterday, and I totally would’ve regretted not coming here!
translation: 嗨——～！今天终于能来水疗中心，我太兴奋了！昨天没能来，要是一直错过这里，我绝对会后悔！

source: Isn’t this place cool?!
translation: 这里是不是超棒？！

source: More like hot.
translation: 应该说超热。

source: Shush, Dar.
translation: 嘘，Dar。

source: I guess today is treat-yourself day, huh?
translation: 看来今天是犒劳自己的日子，对吧？

source: Yeah! I heard aromatherapy is really good to reduce stress and boost energy levels~ So we came here for a soak!
translation: 对！听说芳香疗法特别能减轻压力、恢复活力～所以我们就来泡一泡！

source: Hot water is good for muscle pain.
translation: 热水能缓解肌肉酸痛。

source: Why don’t you guys join us then? There’s plenty of room beside me and Yoshi here in the tub!
translation: 那你们也加入我们吧？浴池里我和Yoshi旁边还有很多空位！

source: GAHHH! HOT! HOT! HOT!
translation: 嘎啊！烫！烫！烫！

source: How are you guys withstanding this heat?!
translation: 你们怎么受得了这么烫的水？！

source: It’s nice.
translation: 很舒服。

source: TOTALLY NOT! It feels like I’m being boiled alive!!
translation: 一点都不舒服！感觉我像要被活活煮熟了！！

source: Haha! Don’t worry, you’ll get used to it if you stay in longer~!
translation: 哈哈！别担心，多泡一会儿就会习惯～！

source: Hnghh… This boiling water doesn’t really help. I just can’t get comfy in this bath, no matter how I sit!
translation: 嗯啊……这么烫的水也没什么帮助。不管怎么坐，我在浴池里都找不到舒服的姿势！

source: Oh, what’s the matter, Lloyd? Are you hurt somewhere?
translation: 哦，怎么了，Lloyd？哪里受伤了吗？

source: Sort of… I’ve been limping all day thanks to Dar over here! This guy doesn’t know how to take it easy!
translation: 算是吧……都怪旁边这个Dar，我今天一整天走路都一瘸一拐！这家伙根本不知道什么叫温柔！

source: I’m pretty sore too.
translation: 我也挺酸痛的。

source: Oho~ Did you guys have a group ‘workout’ yesterday~?
translation: 哦嚯～你们昨天集体“锻炼”了吗～？

source: Yeah! We tried so many positions. It’s been a while since we got to sweat together like that.
translation: 对啊！我们尝试了好多姿势。已经很久没像那样一起挥汗了。

source: H-How are you all talking so casually about this…?
translation: 你、你们怎么能这么若无其事地聊这种事……？

source: Huh? We’re talking about our exercise sesh yesterday! I was doing yoga and he was lifting!
translation: 嗯？我们在聊昨天的锻炼啊！我做瑜伽，他举重！

source: Naughty Yoshi.
translation: Yoshi真色。

source: A-Ack…!
Hahaha! That’s what you get for sticking around me too much, Yoshi~
translation: 哈哈哈！谁让你总和我待在一起呢，Yoshi～

source: It’s a bath. There’s no point.
translation: 这里是浴场。没必要围。

source: L-Lloyd! Don’t talk so loudly! People are staring…!
translation: 劳、Lloyd！别说这么大声！别人都在看……！

source: Ehh… They already were. I mean… who wouldn’t look at his giraffe shaft?!
translation: 呃……他们本来就在看。我是说……谁能忍住不看他那根长颈鹿似的巨根？！

source: Heck yeah! Look at it swinging around like an elephant trunk!
translation: 可不是嘛！看它像大象鼻子一样甩来甩去！

source: Free safari.
translation: 免费野生动物园。

source: Guys, is this really the best topic?
translation: 各位，我们真的非得聊这个吗？

source: Hehe, you were ogling it too, Yoshi~ Don't act innocent!
translation: 嘿嘿，你刚才也盯着看呢，Yoshi～别装无辜！

source: Y-You guys are the ones who keep pointing it out!
translation: 明、明明是你们一直在强调它！

source: I don't mind.
translation: 我不介意。

source: I DO! Stop looking, all of you!
translation: 我介意！你们都别看了！

source: He's cranky because of his butt cramps.
translation: 他是屁股抽痛，所以才这么暴躁。

source: Hehe~ Maybe he needs you to loosen them up again?
translation: 嘿嘿～说不定需要你再帮他松一松？

source: Ooh, ooh, good idea! Come on Dar, let's go get a room and you can give me that deep massage you promised!
translation: 哦哦，好主意！来吧Dar，我们去开个房，你可以给我做答应过的那种深层按摩！

source: Alright.
translation: 好。

source: Don’t be surprised if you need a wheelchair after.
translation: 做完后要是得坐轮椅，可别惊讶。

source: We’ll go ahead, you guys!
translation: 各位，我们先走啦！

source: Haha, see you guys later! Yoshi and I are gonna keep chilling here for now.
translation: 哈哈，待会儿见！我和Yoshi还要在这里继续放松一会儿。

source: Bye, guys!
translation: 再见，各位！

source: Hahaha! Guess my prophecy about Darius splitting someone in half will come true.
translation: 哈哈哈！看来我预言Darius会把某人捅成两半，马上就要成真了。

source: {i}Aiden and I stayed a little longer, relaxing and recovering from last night.{/i}
translation: {i}我和Aiden又待了一会儿，一边放松，一边从昨晚的疲惫中恢复。{/i}

source: {i}Eventually, we decided to get out and explore another area of the hotel! {/i}
translation: {i}最后，我们决定离开这里，去探索酒店的其他区域！{/i}

source: {i}Aiden and I stayed a little longer, relaxing and enjoying the afternoon.{/i}
translation: {i}我和Aiden又待了一会儿，放松地享受着午后时光。{/i}

source: We could grab something to eat over at the café!
translation: 我们可以去咖啡厅吃点东西！

source: Sure thing! I’m feeling pretty hungry too!
translation: 好啊！我也觉得很饿了！

source: Yikes, Emilia is here…
translation: 糟糕，Emilia也在这里……

source: Guess we know why Yuri didn’t hang out here, huh?
translation: 现在知道Yuri为什么没来这里闲逛了，对吧？

source: Looks like she’s harassing that waiter too…
translation: 看来她还在刁难那个服务员……

source: And it looks like she’s harassing that waiter…
translation: 而且她好像正在刁难那个服务员……

source: I can’t believe you served me something raw! Touch this meat and tell me that’s not just taken straight out of the fridge!
translation: 真不敢相信你们居然给我上生肉！摸摸这块肉，然后告诉我它不是刚从冰箱里拿出来的！

source: You ordered prosciutto, ma’am… And it’s from our cold cuts menu…
translation: 您点的是意式熏火腿，女士……而且它属于我们的冷盘菜单……

source: I-I knew that! But I’m not trying to get salmonella on my vacation, is that too hard to understand?!
translation: 我、我当然知道！但我可不想度假时感染沙门氏菌，这很难理解吗？！

source: U-Um… No, I’m sorry. Maybe you would prefer some bacon or ham instead?
translation: 呃、嗯……不，十分抱歉。也许您更喜欢培根或火腿？

source: I didn’t come here to eat something that common! Now, cook this meat up before I sue this entire place!
translation: 我来这里可不是为了吃那么普通的东西！现在把这块肉做熟，否则我就起诉整家酒店！

source: S-Sure… Right away, ma’am.
translation: 好、好的……马上为您处理，女士。

source: *sigh* Can’t even have a good time around here…
translation: *叹气* 在这里连好好享受一下都做不到……

source: Oh crap! She saw us…!
translation: 糟糕！她看见我们了……！

source: I’ll go order something and get a table for us! Distract her for me, Yoshi!
translation: 我去点餐再找张桌子！Yoshi，帮我拖住她！

source: A-Aiden, wait…!
translation: 艾、Aiden，等等……！

source: Are you just going to stand over there and pretend I didn’t see you?
translation: 你打算一直站在那里，假装我没看到你吗？

source: Aiden and I are actually here to grab a meal. We just happened to notice you were having a problem with the staff again.
translation: 其实我和Aiden是来吃饭的。我们只是碰巧注意到你又和工作人员起了争执。

source: Hmph! If you assumed I needed you or anyone’s help then you’re sorely mistaken.
translation: 哼！如果你以为我需要你或任何人的帮助，那就大错特错了。

source: Well… It’s hard to think otherwise seeing you stressed out like this even though we’re on vacation.
translation: 这个嘛……我们明明在度假，你却这么焦躁，很难不让人这么想。

source: In fact, I haven’t seen you hang out with anyone since we got here… Maybe you should try to join us and use this chance to get to know everyone!
translation: 事实上，从来到这里后，我就没见你和任何人一起活动过……也许你该试着加入我们，趁这个机会了解大家！

source: You have the nerve to tell me that? Don’t tell me how I should spend my time!
translation: 你居然有脸对我说这种话？别告诉我该怎么支配自己的时间！

source: N-No, Emilia. I was only trying to—
translation: 不、不是，Emilia。我只是想——

source: None of you invited me anyway, so why should I bother squeezing myself into a group who doesn’t give a damn in the first place?
translation: 反正你们谁都没邀请过我，我为什么还要费力挤进一个根本不在乎我的群体？

source: I’d rather be alone than spend my precious time pretending to be friends with people like you.
translation: 与其浪费宝贵时间，假装和你们这种人是朋友，我宁愿独处。

source: *sigh* Emilia…
translation: *叹气* Emilia……

source: What?!
translation: 干什么？！

source: I just don’t understand… What are you getting out of this?
translation: 我只是不明白……你这样做究竟能得到什么？

source: You’re pushing everyone away and letting all of us think that you hate us…
translation: 你把所有人都推开，让我们大家都以为你讨厌我们……

source: Who are we kidding here, Yoshinori? I hate all of you, and you all hate me. There’s no secret there.
translation: 还装什么呢，Yoshinori？我讨厌你们所有人，你们也都讨厌我。这根本不是什么秘密。

source: Even if I tell you that’s not true, you wouldn’t believe me anyway.
translation: 即使我告诉你事实并非如此，你也不会相信。

source: But I at least thought you’d feel a little ‘at-home’ with all of these fancy things around.
translation: 但我至少以为，周围有这么多高档东西，你会觉得有点“宾至如归”。

source: It’s nowhere close to what I’m used to.
translation: 这里离我习惯的标准差远了。

source: You know I have high standards, considering I get way better food, service and atmosphere at home than at this mediocre hotel!
translation: 你知道我的标准很高，毕竟我在家享受的食物、服务和环境，都比这家平庸酒店好得多！

source: But don’t get me wrong, this is far more bearable than having to stay in that raggedy camp.
translation: 不过别误会，这里还是比待在那个破旧营地里好受多了。

source: It really doesn’t make sense to me why you even chose to come back and work with us if you hate it so much…
translation: 既然你那么讨厌那里，我实在不明白你为什么还选择回来和我们一起工作……

source: GRAH! Why are you suddenly probing me about all of this?! As if I needed one more person to keep scrutinizing everything I do!
translation: 嘎啊！你为什么突然追问我这些事？！难道审视我一举一动的人还不够多吗！

source: This is exactly why I wanted to be alone in the first place!
translation: 所以我从一开始就想一个人待着！

source: N-No, Emilia wait—
translation: 不、不是，Emilia，等等——

source: Not again…
translation: 又搞砸了……

source: Is the coast clear?
translation: 危险解除了吗？

source: Sheesh, Yoshi… That was messy…
translation: 天啊，Yoshi……场面真难看……

source: It looks like there’s no chance any of us can get along with her. She’s made up her mind that we’re all out to get her.
translation: 看来我们谁都没机会和她好好相处。她已经认定所有人都想害她。

source: You know she’s always been like that…
translation: 你知道她一直都是那样……

source: Even when you guys were scouts, all she ever did was complain and push people away…
translation: 就连你们还是童子军时，她也只会抱怨，把别人推开……

source: I don’t think that was her intent… She had a lot of problems to deal with, even back then.
translation: 我觉得那不是她的本意……即使在当时，她也有很多问题要面对。

source: Really? If I was as rich as her, I’d have nothing to whine about!
translation: 真的吗？我要是像她那么有钱，根本不会有任何值得抱怨的事！

source: It’s a lot more complicated than that…
translation: 事情远比这复杂……

source: Hnghh... This wagon really needs some oil…
translation: 嗯啊……这辆手推车真该上点油了……

source: I should’ve dragged Aiden with me, he’d know what to do to fix this!
translation: 早知道就把Aiden拉过来了，他肯定知道该怎么修！

source: I demand you come here and pick me up from this place once and for all!
translation: 我要求你们马上过来，把我彻底接离这个地方！

source: Everything here is primitive and disgusting! And the commoners here make me sick!
translation: 这里的一切都原始又恶心！这里的平民更让我反胃！

source: Surely there was a better option than this trashy camp! At the very least you could’ve let me stay at home alone!
translation: 肯定有比这个破营地更好的选择！至少你们可以让我一个人待在家里！

source: I can’t stand being here for another minute! Why did you even send me here?!
translation: 我一分钟都无法再忍受这里！你们为什么要把我送来？！

source: I-I know that you’re out of the country! Shouldn’t I have gone with you?!
translation: 我、我知道你们出国了！难道不该带我一起去吗？！

source: You’re always leaving me behind! And all you and Dad ever do is scold me when you’re around!
translation: 你们总是把我丢下！而且你和爸爸在我身边时，也只会责骂我！

source: It’s like you don’t even care about me! You’re the worst—
translation: 你们简直一点都不在乎我！你们最差劲了——

source: Did you really send me here just to punish me?!
translation: 你们把我送来这里，真的是为了惩罚我吗？！

source: I-I don’t need strangers giving me useless life lessons!
translation: 我、我不需要陌生人给我上那些没用的人生课！

source: Wh-What…?! N-No! You can’t do that!!
translation: 什、什么……？！不、不行！你不能这样！！

source: Mom, please!! Don’t leave me here!
translation: 妈妈，求你了！！别把我留在这里！

source: GRAHHH!!!
translation: 嘎啊啊！！！

source: *throws phone on the ground*
translation: *把手机摔在地上*

source: Stupid camp! Stupid parents! Stupid everything!!
translation: 破营地！烂父母！所有东西都糟透了！！

source: A-Are you alright, Emilia?
translation: 你、你没事吧，Emilia？

source: How long have you been standing there?! Were you spying on me?!
translation: 你在那里站多久了？！你在监视我吗？！

source: N-No, I was just passing by and I heard you screaming on the phone…
translation: 不、不是，我只是路过，听到你在电话里大喊……

source: It’s none of your business! And don’t you dare tell anyone what you’ve heard!
translation: 这不关你的事！而且你敢把听到的内容告诉别人试试看！

source: Y-Your phone, though… It’s broken… I can ask a scoutmaster to fix it.
translation: 可、可是你的手机……摔坏了……我可以请童子军长帮忙修理。

source: You’re just gonna use that to get me in trouble, aren’t you?!
translation: 你只是想借这件事害我受罚，对吧？！

source: N-No, that’s not—
translation: 不、不是，不是那样——

source: Shut up! Just leave me alone like everyone else!!!
translation: 闭嘴！像其他人一样丢下我不管就好了！！！

source: Yikes… It sounds like her parents are even worse than her…
translation: 天啊……听起来她的父母比她还糟糕……

source: I never got the full the story but, it helps me understand why she acts like that…
translation: 我从没听到完整的经过，不过这让我明白她为什么会表现成那样……

source: No wonder you were always so nice to her. But then, you’re always nice to everyone.
translation: 难怪你一直对她那么友善。不过话说回来，你对所有人都很好。

source: Well.. You never know what’s going on behind the scenes in people’s lives, so it’s best to give them the benefit of the doubt…
translation: 这个嘛……你永远不知道别人生活背后发生着什么，所以最好先往善意的方向理解……

source: Still, doesn’t give her an excuse for that attitude.
translation: 但这仍然不能成为她态度恶劣的借口。

source: I agree…
translation: 我同意……

source: Anyways, I got us both some snacks… Let’s eat and forget about all that drama.
translation: 总之，我给咱俩买了些点心……吃点东西，把那些麻烦事忘掉吧。

source: Sure, Aiden. Thanks.
translation: 好，Aiden。谢谢。

source: {i}Somehow, whenever Emilia and I interact, it always ends up so tense… I wish there was a way to reach her like I could back then.{/i}
translation: {i}不知为什么，我和Emilia每次交流，最后都会变得如此紧张……真希望还能像当年一样找到打动她的办法。{/i}

source: {i}But I can only do so much, and she’s not willing to meet me halfway…{/i}
translation: {i}但我能做的终究有限，而她也不愿意向我迈出一步……{/i}

source: {i}Thankfully, Aiden was there to get my mind off of her.{/i}
translation: {i}幸好Aiden陪在身边，让我不再纠结于她。{/i}

source: Why don’t we head over to the other rooms and see what they’re doing?
translation: 我们去其他人的房间，看看他们在做什么吧？

source: Sure! Let’s just hope we don’t interrupt something, hehe~
translation: 好啊！只希望我们别打断什么好事，嘿嘿～

source: Why don’t we go and check on Jin? He might need some encouragement getting out of his room.
translation: 我们去看看Jin吧？也许他需要有人鼓励一下，才肯走出房间。

source: Sure! Let’s head over there.
translation: 好啊！我们过去吧。

source: O-Oh, coming! Give me just a moment!
translation: 哦、哦，来了！请稍等一下！

source: Ah! Hello again, you two!
translation: 啊！又见面了，你们两个！

source: Jin? What are you doing back in the room already?
translation: Jin？你怎么已经回房间了？

source: Yeah, weren’t you enjoying a snoopfest with Yuri?
translation: 是啊，你不是正和Yuri愉快地到处窥探吗？

source: W-Well, we were trying to, but Sir Goro actually found us shortly after you guys left.
translation: 这、这个嘛，本来是的，可你们离开后没多久，Goro先生就发现了我们。

source: Yuri didn’t want us to get scolded, so she made me run with the laptop before he noticed…
translation: Yuri不想让我们挨训，所以趁他还没注意到，就让我抱着笔记本跑掉了……

source: *sigh* You make it sound like it was a whole criminal operation or something…
translation: *叹气* 你说得好像那是什么完整的犯罪行动一样……

source: Haha, can’t blame Jin though! He was probably ready to get back to the room anyway~
translation: 哈哈，不过也不能怪Jin！他大概早就准备好回房间了～

source: I-I was starting to feel a little too exposed out there…
translation: 我、我开始觉得待在外面太没有安全感了……

source: Ah! Hello, you two!
translation: 啊！你们好！

source: Hello, Jin! We were coming to see if you’d gotten out into the hotel yet.
translation: 你好，Jin！我们来看看你有没有走出房间，在酒店里逛一逛。

source: Guess the answer is no.
translation: 看来答案是没有。

source: A-Actually, I did try and tag along with Lloyd and Darius to the bathhouse earlier…!
translation: 其、其实我早些时候试着跟Lloyd和Darius去了浴场……！

source: Ohoho, now that sounds like something you’d be more interested in~
translation: 哦嚯嚯，这听起来确实更符合你的兴趣～

source: I-I thought so too, but it definitely got too hot and heavy in there for me to handle…
translation: 我、我本来也这么想，可里面实在太过火、太激烈，我承受不了……

source: Aww, Jin! You know you’re supposed to wait a while to adjust before pulling out.
translation: 哎呀，Jin！你应该先等一会儿适应，再拔出来。

source: Hehe, yeah Jin, you’re supposed to take it slow – if you go too fast, it can be painful~
translation: 嘿嘿，没错Jin，你得慢慢来——太快的话会很痛哦～

source: *ehem* Anyway, are you alright in here by yourself?
translation: *咳咳* 总之，你一个人待在这里没问题吗？

source: O-Oh, yes, I’m totally fine! This place is a little out of my element, anyway…
translation: 哦、哦，当然，我完全没问题！反正这种地方本来也不太适合我……

source: Huh? What do you mean?
translation: 嗯？什么意思？

source: Oh! I think I get it.
translation: 哦！我想我懂了。

source: Jin here is like me, he prefers the outdoors! A place this fancy can feel too stuffy for our liking.
translation: Jin和我一样，更喜欢户外！这么奢华的地方对我们来说会显得太拘束。

source: Isn’t that right, Jin?
translation: 对吧，Jin？

source: I-It’s just… a place like this has a little too much hustle and bustle for someone like me…
translation: 只、只是……这种地方对我这样的人来说有点太喧闹忙乱了……

source: I can understand that, but you won’t know what you’re missing unless you give it a chance!
translation: 我能理解，但如果不给它一次机会，你就不会知道自己错过了什么！

source: Give him a break, Yoshi! Maybe Jin is more like me, and prefers the outdoors~
translation: 别逼他了，Yoshi！也许Jin更像我，喜欢待在户外～

source: Right, Jin?
translation: 对吧，Jin？

source: W-Well… Yeah, kind of like Camp Buddy.
translation: 这、这个嘛……是啊，就像伙伴营那样。

source: Haha, you shoulda been with us last term, when we went to the beach with the scouts!
translation: 哈哈，上个营期我们带童子军去海滩时，你真该和我们一起！

source: I bet that’s way more up your alley!
translation: 我敢说那肯定更合你的胃口！

source: *gasp* A beach episode?!
translation: *倒吸一口气* 海滩回？！

source: Yup! Just sun, sand, and all the beach bods you can imagine!
translation: 没错！阳光、沙滩，还有你能想象到的各种海滩肉体！

source: Hngh…!!
*sigh* Don’t get him worked up, Aiden…
translation: *叹气* 别让他兴奋过头，Aiden……

source: What? It’s true! I had on the tiniest white swimsuit too, Jin~
translation: 怎么？我说的是真的！而且我当时还穿着一条小得不能再小的白色泳裤，Jin～

source: Y-You have to tell me all the details, right now!
translation: 你、你现在就得把所有细节都告诉我！

source: Oh yeah! You can add that to that blog you’ve been working on!
translation: 哦，对了！你可以把这件事加到一直在写的博客里！

source: It’ll be a special section about the spiciest moments with a certain someone~
translation: 就做成特别版块，记录我和某个人最火辣的时刻～

source: *winks at Yoshinori*
translation: *向Yoshinori眨眼*

source: A-Aiden! I don’t think that’s appropriate for—
translation: 艾、Aiden！我觉得这不适合写进——

source: YES, IT IS! I INSIST!
translation: 不，非常适合！我坚持要听！

source: LET ME GRAB MY LAPTOP RIGHT NOW!
translation: 我现在就去拿笔记本电脑！

source: Alright~!
translation: 好啊～！

source: *sigh* Are we really doing this…?
translation: *叹气* 我们真要这么做吗……？

source: Phew… I finally got a chance to get changed too.
translation: 呼……我终于也有机会换好衣服了。

source: Now that we have the tents set up, I should start getting the first activity ready!
translation: 现在帐篷已经搭好，我该开始准备第一个活动了！

source: Let’s see—
translation: 让我看看——

source: Oh! There you are, Yoshi!
translation: 哦！原来你在这里，Yoshi！

source: A-Aiden! What the heck are you wearing?!
translation: 艾、Aiden！你到底穿的是什么？！

source: You like it? Yuri got me this suit just for the occasion!
translation: 喜欢吗？Yuri专门为这次活动给我买的泳裤！

source: She said it contrasts with my skin tone nicely~
translation: 她说它和我的肤色形成的对比特别好看～

source: But it’s… barely covering anything…
translation: 可是它……几乎什么都遮不住……

source: This is teeeechnically more than usual!
translation: 严格——来说，这已经比平时穿得多了！

source: *sigh* That’s true, but your apron at least covers your crotch completely…
translation: *叹气* 话是这么说，可你的围裙至少能把胯下完全遮住……

source: With this, it’s… well…
translation: 而这条泳裤……这个嘛……

source: Ohoho~ Can’t help but stare at my junk, Yoshi?
translation: 哦嚯嚯～忍不住盯着我的宝贝看吗，Yoshi？

source: *ehem* W-Well, in any case, I should really start preparing the next activity.
translation: *咳咳* 这、这个嘛，无论如何，我真的该开始准备下一个活动了。

source: What? We just got here!
translation: 什么？我们才刚到这里！

source: We’re on vacation, and we just had the sportsfest too! Loosen up a little!
translation: 我们是在度假，而且才刚办完运动会！放松一点吧！

source: I-I’m not sure—
translation: 我、我不确定——

source: I’m sure for you! Come on, let’s go swim!
translation: 我替你确定了！来吧，我们去游泳！

source: A-Aiden, wait—
translation: 艾、Aiden，等等——

source: Whew, the water feels great!
translation: 呼，水里真舒服！

source: Get in here, Yoshi! Come swim!
translation: 下来吧，Yoshi！快来游泳！

source: Haha, you’re just as energetic as ever, Aiden.
translation: 哈哈，你还是一如既往地精力充沛，Aiden。

source: You’ve hardly changed from when we were younger.
translation: 和年轻时相比，你几乎一点都没变。

source: And you still ramble about cheesy stuff like there’s no tomorrow!
translation: 你也还是会没完没了地说这些肉麻话！

source: Quit stalling and take a d—
translation: 别拖时间了，快跳下——

source: G-G-GREAT WHITE SHANK!
translation: 大、大、大白鲨！

source: S-Shark?! WHERE?!
translation: 鲨、鲨鱼？！在哪儿？！

source: N-No, Aiden! Y-Your suit! Cover your crotch up, before anyone else sees!
translation: 不、不是，Aiden！你、你的泳裤！快把胯下遮住，别让其他人看见！

source: Sheesh, Yoshi, I almost had a heart attack!
translation: 天啊，Yoshi，我差点被你吓得心脏病发！

source: *gulp* Don’t be silly, Aiden. You know we can’t do stuff like that here, at least not when there could be scouts around.
translation: *咽口水* 别胡闹，Aiden。你知道我们不能在这里做那种事，至少童子军可能在附近时不行。

source: Oh yeah? I think the bulge in your pants disagrees~
translation: 是吗？我觉得你裤子里的鼓包可不同意～

source: W-What…?! I’m not—
translation: 什、什么……？！我没有——

source: Oh I dunno, Yoshi~ I’m not convinced ’til I get a closer look!
translation: 哦，我可不知道，Yoshi～除非让我靠近看看，否则我不信！

source: B-Beach… W-White foam…
translation: 海、海滩……白、白色泡沫……

source: You know, it was probably a good thing we were in the water, or there would’ve been no way to clean up that mess.
translation: 现在想想，幸好我们当时在水里，不然那一摊东西根本没法收拾。

source: *sigh* And I remember my thing feeling numb for the rest of the day after that too.
translation: *叹气* 我还记得那之后我的那玩意儿麻了整整一天。

source: I gotta admit, I felt so full after I couldn’t eat a single bite of lunch or dinner, hahaha!
translation: 不得不承认，做完后我撑得午饭晚饭一口都吃不下，哈哈哈！

source: Cream… Pie…
It was a miracle nobody found us, or else it would’ve been a disaster.
translation: 没人发现我们简直是奇迹，否则就要酿成大祸了。

source: I can’t even imagine what would’ve happened if Sir Goro and the scouts caught us… Or worse, Yuri…
translation: 我都不敢想象，要是Goro先生和童子军撞见会怎么样……更糟的是，被Yuri撞见……

source: So, Jin~ How was that for a spicy story~?
translation: 所以，Jin～这个火辣故事怎么样～？

source: Uhh… We might’ve overloaded him again, Aiden…
translation: 呃……我们可能又让他过载了，Aiden……

source: Oh something’s overloaded for sure. Just look at his pants~
translation: 肯定有什么东西过载了。看看他的裤子就知道～

source: Gah! J-Jin!
translation: 嘎！J、Jin！

source: I have to go… to the toilet…
translation: 我得去……厕所……

source: Hahaha! Guess we really worked him up~
translation: 哈哈哈！看来我们真的把他撩起来了～

source: *sigh* And it looks like he didn’t even write anything down on his laptop.
translation: *叹气* 而且看来他连一个字都没记进笔记本。

source: Although, that might be for the best… We shouldn’t publish anything like that on the blog.
translation: 不过这样也许最好……我们不该把这种内容发布到博客上。

source: Let’s just fill out a story about the activities while Jin, uhh… takes care of his business.
translation: 趁Jin去……呃，处理自己的事情，我们就写写活动经过吧。

source: HNGHGHGHGGHH!
translation: 嗯呃呃呃啊啊！

source: {i}We spent the next while typing out some of the fun events we’d done at the beach on Jin’s laptop.{/i}
translation: {i}接下来一段时间，我们用Jin的笔记本记录了在海滩经历的一些趣事。{/i}

source: {i}After he calmed down, Jin joined us and helped get the next entry ready.{/i}
translation: {i}冷静下来后，Jin加入我们，帮忙准备了下一篇博文。{/i}

source: {i}Eventually, we decided to get out and explore another area of the hotel!{/i}
translation: {i}最后，我们决定离开这里，去探索酒店的其他区域！{/i}

source: Whew… it’s really getting chillier, huh?
translation: 呼……天气真的越来越冷了，对吧？

source: W-Well, you’re barely wearing anything, Aiden…
translation: 这、这个嘛，你几乎什么都没穿，Aiden……

source: Can’t help it! I wanna feel these premium sheets rub against my skin!
translation: 没办法！我想感受这些高级床单摩擦皮肤的触感！

source: But seriously, have you noticed that it’s been snowing nonstop the whole time we’ve been here?
translation: 不过说真的，你注意到我们来到这里后，雪就一直没停过吗？

source: Oh yeah, I saw. It looks like it’s not stopping anytime soon either.
translation: 哦，对，我看到了。看来短时间内也不会停。

source: Feels good to have a warm and cozy room, without all the troubles of setting up a fireplace! Hahaha!
translation: 不用费劲生壁炉，就能住在温暖舒适的房间里，感觉真好！哈哈哈！

source: Don’t get me wrong, I’d pick our cozy cabins over a thousand-dollar room like this any day!
translation: 不过别误会，要我选的话，我随时都会选我们舒适的小屋，而不是这种一千美元一晚的房间！

source: Well, I’m just glad you’re starting to enjoy your time here, Aiden.
translation: 好吧，我只是很高兴你开始享受这里的时光了，Aiden。

source: I wouldn’t if it weren’t for you.
translation: 要不是有你，我才不会享受。

source: But I’m still a little on edge by how lavish everything is. Makes me really miss our simple life back at camp.
translation: 不过周围的一切都太奢华，还是让我有些不自在。真怀念营地里简单的生活。

source: I get you. It’s only been two days, and I have to admit I’m feeling kind of homesick too.
translation: 我懂。才过两天，我也得承认自己有点想家了。

source: Good thing we don’t have any plans for tonight, I’d rather just stay in our room and wait for this trip to end!
translation: 幸好今晚没什么安排，我宁愿待在房间里，等这趟旅行结束！

source: Oh? Who could that be?
translation: 哦？会是谁呢？

source: Hi, guys~!
translation: 嗨，各位～！

source: Hey, Yuri~ Hey, Gramps!
translation: 嘿，Yuri～嘿，Gramps！

source: Oh? Are we interrupting something here~?
translation: 哦？我们是不是打扰了什么好事～？

source: Not at all!
translation: 完全没有！

source: That’s nothing new, Yuri. He’s actually wearing more than usual.
translation: 这没什么稀奇的，Yuri。他其实比平时穿得还多。

source: You know how men are, dear.
translation: 亲爱的，你知道男人就是这样。

source: Hehe, what made you guys drop by? Need anything?
translation: 嘿嘿，你们怎么过来了？有什么事吗？

source: Ah, we were informed that we have a scheduled formal dinner tonight down at the restaurant.
translation: 啊，我们刚收到通知，今晚餐厅安排了一场正式晚宴。

source: *whistles* Fancy…
translation: *吹口哨* 真气派……

source: And I thought we were done getting spoiled…
translation: 我还以为奢侈享受已经结束了……

source: Yeah, it was another surprise arrangement by Mr. Clermont.
translation: 是啊，这又是Clermont先生安排的惊喜。

source: Sheesh... He really has that much money to blow on peeps like us? You sure the guy just doesn’t have a crush on you, Gramps?
translation: 天啊……他真有这么多钱花在我们这种人身上？Gramps，你确定那家伙不是暗恋你吗？

source: Wh-What…? Where did that even come from?!
translation: 什、什么……？你怎么会想到那里去？！

source: Just so you all know. This is simply part of the VIP-Class package he got for us.
translation: 告诉你们，这只是他为我们预订的VIP级套餐的一部分。

source: W-Wait, did you say formal dinner, sir? I don’t think any of us packed appropriate clothing for something like this…
translation: 等、等等，先生，您刚才说正式晚宴？我们好像都没带适合这种场合的衣服……

source: Well… Mr. Clermont expected that, so he made provisions for us.
translation: 这个嘛……Clermont先生料到了，所以已经替我们做好准备。

source: Here. The hotel staff delivered us sets of formalwear to choose from.
translation: 给。酒店工作人员送来了几套正装，供我们挑选。

source: He asked me for everyone’s uniform measurements a few weeks ago, so he got all of our sizes.
translation: 几周前他向我要了大家的制服尺寸，所以每个人的尺码都有。

source: Whoa… Mr. Clermont’s really gone overboard with this…
translation: 哇……Clermont先生这次真是太夸张了……

source: I know. As much as we’re all overwhelmed by his generosity, it would be best to just appreciate it.
translation: 我知道。尽管他的慷慨让我们都有些不知所措，最好还是心怀感激地接受。

source: I don’t know about you guys, but I won’t be saying no to a fancy dinner night~!
translation: 不知道你们怎么想，反正我可不会拒绝一场豪华晚宴～！

source: Why don’t you start trying these suits on to see what matches your style~?
translation: 你们先试试这些西装，看看哪一套最符合自己的风格吧～？

source: E-Eh… I don’t know if any of this would look right on me…
translation: 呃、呃……我不知道这些衣服穿在我身上会不会合适……

source: Anything would look good on hunks like you two, for sure~! Here, try this one, Aiden~!
translation: 你们两个帅哥穿什么都一定好看～！来，Aiden，试试这套～！

source: They’re grown men. You don’t have to dress them like dolls.
translation: 他们是成年人了。你没必要像摆弄玩偶一样替他们打扮。

source: Aww…
translation: 哎呀……

source: Anyway, we still have to inform the others and bring them their suits.
translation: 总之，我们还得通知其他人，把西装送过去。

source: Our reservation is in thirty minutes. Let’s all meet there.
translation: 预约时间是三十分钟后。大家到餐厅集合。

source: Yes, sir. We’ll get dressed immediately.
translation: 是，先生。我们马上换衣服。

source: See you guys soon! Can’t wait to see your formal looks~!
translation: 待会儿见！真等不及看你们穿正装的样子～！

source: Whew… Just when I thought tonight’s gonna be chill…
translation: 呼……我还以为今晚能悠闲度过……

source: We’ll get to eat great food though! Aren’t you excited about that?
translation: 不过我们能吃到美味佳肴！你不期待吗？

source: You never know, maybe you’ll get some ideas for a new camp menu!
translation: 谁知道呢，也许你能从中找到营地新菜单的灵感！

source: They’re probably using expensive ingredients, though… I’m much more used to making homey food with cheap stuff…
translation: 可他们用的恐怕都是昂贵食材……我更习惯用便宜材料做家常菜……

source: And do I really have to dress up like an aristocrat?
translation: 而且我真的非得打扮得像个贵族吗？

source: Hehe, you never know, the look might fit you~
translation: 嘿嘿，谁知道呢，说不定这种造型很适合你～

source: Oh, I dunno… Something about this whole thing is making me low-key anxious…
translation: 哦，我不知道……整件事不知怎么让我有点焦虑……

source: Ughhh… Do we really have to go, Yoshi??
translation: 呃啊……我们真的非去不可吗，Yoshi？？

source: Ughhh… Do we really have to go, Yoshi??{fast}
translation: 呃啊……我们真的非去不可吗，Yoshi？？{fast}

source: We can't just turn it down.
translation: 我们不能直接拒绝。

source: It’d be really rude to turn down Mr. Clermont’s generous offer.
translation: 拒绝Clermont先生如此慷慨的邀请会非常失礼。

source: *sigh* You’re right...
translation: *叹气* 你说得对……

source: You gotta help me with this tie, though. I know how to tie a knot twenty different ways, but I have no clue what to do with this thing.
translation: 不过你得帮我系领带。我会二十种绳结，却完全不知道这东西该怎么系。

source: Hehe, here let me do it for you.
translation: 嘿嘿，来，我帮你。

source: Everyone else is going.
translation: 其他人都会去。

source: Ahehe… We have to. Everyone’s gonna look for us if we don’t show up.
translation: 啊嘿嘿……我们必须去。要是不露面，大家都会来找我们。

source: It's a chance to spend time with everyone.
translation: 这是和大家共度时光的机会。

source: Think of it as a chance to have a nice dinner with everyone!
translation: 就把它当成和大家一起享用美好晚餐的机会！

source: And this time, you don’t have to do any work!
translation: 而且这次你完全不用干活！

source: Well, if you put it that way…
translation: 好吧，既然你这么说……

source: There's nothing to worry about.
translation: 没什么好担心的。

source: There’s nothing to worry about, Aiden.
translation: 没什么好担心的，Aiden。

source: Think of it as a fancy date for the two of us!
translation: 就把它当成我们两人的豪华约会吧！

source: Hehe, if you put it that way…
translation: 嘿嘿，既然你这么说……

source: Over here, Aiden! Come check the place out!
translation: 这边，Aiden！快来看看这里！

source: Y-Yeah, I’m coming—
translation: 好、好，我来了——

source: I should’ve expected this considering the rest of the hotel, but this place is incredible…
translation: 考虑到酒店其他地方的样子，我早该料到，但这里还是太惊人了……

source: No kidding…
translation: 可不是嘛……

source: Everywhere you look there’s gold and crystals, it’s almost blinding me. You sure this is a restaurant?
translation: 放眼望去到处都是黄金和水晶，简直快把我闪瞎了。你确定这里是餐厅？

source: This is where Yuri told us to go… But I don’t see anyone else yet.
translation: Yuri说的就是这里……可我还没看到其他人。

source: Being in a place like this is kinda freaking me out, it’s almost suffocating.
translation: 待在这种地方让我有点慌，几乎喘不过气来。

source: That or this necktie is choking me to death!
translation: 也可能是这条领带快把我勒死了！

source: Oh, let me loosen that for you.
translation: 哦，我帮你松一松。

source: *sigh* This suit isn’t helping either. It’s hugging my body way too tight.
translation: *叹气* 这套西装也没好到哪去。把我的身体裹得太紧了。

source: And what’s up with these shoes? I can’t even walk properly in them.
translation: 还有这双鞋是怎么回事？穿着它我连路都走不好。

source: Relax, Aiden. This is what formal wear is supposed to feel like.
translation: 放松，Aiden。正装穿起来本来就是这种感觉。

source: But don’t worry, you look really handsome in it.
translation: 不过别担心，你穿起来真的很帅。

source: Ahehe… Thanks, Yoshi. It suits you way better though.
translation: 啊嘿嘿……谢谢，Yoshi。不过它更适合你。

source: It’s been a long time since I wore something this nice.
translation: 我已经很久没穿过这么好的衣服了。

source: Business suits are one thing, but the last time I was in full formal wear was my prom.
translation: 商务西装另当别论，上次穿全套正装还是在毕业舞会上。

source: Prom? I’ve never went to one. Too bad, ’cause I would’ve loved to go with you.
translation: 毕业舞会？我从来没参加过。真可惜，不然我一定很想和你一起去。

source: Haha, well it’s not too different from this except with dancing and some extra cringe.
translation: 哈哈，其实和现在差不多，只是多了跳舞和一些尴尬场面。

source: And I don’t think it’d be nearly as memorable as this.
translation: 而且我觉得那也不会像今晚这么难忘。

source: Hehe, I guess this could be fun just for tonight... Even though these clothes are stuffy, we do look good together, don’t we?
translation: 嘿嘿，看来今晚偶尔这样也挺有趣……虽然衣服很拘束，但我们站在一起确实很好看，对吧？

source: Yeah, we blend right in!
translation: 是啊，我们完全融入这里了！

source: Hiii guuuys!~
translation: 嗨——各位！～

source: You’re both here early. You weren’t lying when you said you’ll get dressed quickly.
translation: 你们两个来得真早。看来你们说会很快换好衣服，并没有撒谎。

source: Oh wow! You both look amazing!
translation: 哇哦！你们两个看起来太棒了！

source: *whistles* Yuri, you look beautiful! I’ve never seen you in a dress before!
translation: *吹口哨* Yuri，你真漂亮！我从没见你穿过裙子！

source: Aww~ Thanks, you guys!
translation: 哎呀～谢谢你们！

source: Hihi~ You both look really handsome too! Formal wear might be my new kink~
translation: 嘻嘻～你们两个也真的很帅！正装说不定会成为我的新癖好～

source: Hehe, good to know you’re still Yuri under there.
translation: 嘿嘿，很高兴知道这身衣服里面还是那个Yuri。

source: I figured we’d get at least one or two comments from you.
translation: 我就知道你至少会说上一两句。

source: She’s been talking nonstop about how excited she was to see you all dressed up...
translation: 她一直说个不停，特别期待看到你们盛装打扮的样子……

source: Don’t let him fool you! He was just as excited as me, talking about you both while he was doing my hair and makeup!
translation: 别被他骗了！他和我一样兴奋，给我做头发和化妆时一直在聊你们两个！

source: Wh-What? Sir Goro did that?
translation: 什、什么？这是Goro先生做的？

source: I had no idea those big manly hands could do something so pretty!
translation: 真没想到那双充满男子气概的大手，竟然能做出这么漂亮的造型！

source: Well… If you have a daughter, you have no choice but to learn at some point in your life…
translation: 这个嘛……有了女儿，人生中迟早都得学会这些……

source: Besides, Yuri takes too much time getting ready for something like this if I leave her to her own devices.
translation: 而且如果放任Yuri自己准备这种场合，她会花上太多时间。

source: Hey! You’re just as bad as me! You spent half the time in front of the mirror deciding which tie matched the best!
translation: 喂！你和我半斤八两！你有一半时间都站在镜子前挑哪条领带最搭！

source: You look great as usual, sir! Formal wear really ‘suits’ you!
translation: 先生，您还是一如既往地帅气！正装真的很“西装”您！

source: That was a seriously bad pun, Yoshi.
translation: 这个双关真的太烂了，Yoshi。

source: It’s actually pretty common for Dad to be in this kind of getup!
translation: 其实爸爸经常穿这种打扮！

source: *ehem* This is a lot more sophisticated than what I usually wear. I even put on my special cologne for this occasion.
translation: *咳咳* 这身比我平时的衣服考究多了。我甚至为这个场合喷了珍藏的古龙水。

source: Oh, you mean that one bottle you've had for like a decade? What was it called…? Huge Boss?
translation: 哦，你是说那瓶放了快十年的？叫什么来着……？巨根老板？

source: Excuse me, it’s called Elongated Musk! It’s my most expensive one to date.
translation: 说什么呢，它叫“绵长麝香”！这是我至今买过最贵的一瓶。

source: Oh! There they are!
translation: 哦！他们来了！

source: Looks like we’re late for the party, huh?
translation: 看来我们迟到了，对吧？

source: Not really! We just got here too!
translation: 没有！我们也才刚到！

source: Lloyd… Um… Didn’t we give you a suit?
translation: Lloyd……呃……我们不是给了你一套西装吗？

source: W-Well… About that…
translation: 这、这个嘛……关于那件事……

source: It didn’t fit him.
translation: 他穿不下。

source: D-Dar!
translation: 达、Dar！

source: Haha! Why, is it like kid-size or something?
translation: 哈哈！怎么，是童装尺码之类的吗？

source: It didn’t fit…? I could’ve sworn I’ve gotten your measurements before, right…?
translation: 穿不下……？我明明记得以前量过你的尺寸，对吧……？

source: W-Well, you did… But I didn’t know it was for something to wear!
translation: 这、这个嘛，确实量过……但我不知道是用来做衣服的！

source: Wait, I’m confused… Why didn’t your suit fit you then?
translation: 等等，我糊涂了……那你的西装为什么不合身？

source: He lied to oversell his size.
translation: 他撒谎夸大了自己的尺寸。

source: Dar… you didn’t have to put it so bluntly…
translation: Dar……你没必要说得这么直接……

source: To be fair, I just thought they were for camp records too when we got asked…
translation: 说实话，当时被问到尺寸时，我也以为只是用来做营地记录……

source: Right?! I thought it was for like a physical checkup or something!
translation: 对吧？！我还以为是体检之类要用的！

source: I didn’t know the reason Mr. Clermont asked for our measurements too, but I didn’t question it.
translation: 我也不知道Clermont先生为什么要我们的尺寸，但我没有多问。

source: Well, it’s a good thing you had something semi-formal… You still look nice nonetheless!
translation: 幸好你还有一套半正式的衣服……不过你看起来仍然很不错！

source: *sigh* I look like a dork compared to you guys…
translation: *叹气* 和你们相比，我看起来像个呆子……

source: I like your bowtie. It’s cute.
translation: 我喜欢你的领结。很可爱。

source: Oh. Maybe this will help out.
translation: 哦。也许这个能帮上忙。

source: I have a brooch that’s perfect for the occasion. It’s not much, but it’ll help a little bit.
translation: 我有一枚很适合这个场合的胸针。虽然不算什么，但多少能增色一些。

source: Oh wow! Thank you, Sir Goro!
translation: 哇哦！谢谢您，Goro先生！

source: Aww, look at that~! It kinda looks like a dad sending his son off to prom~
translation: 哎呀，看看这一幕～！简直像爸爸送儿子去参加毕业舞会～

source: It looks good on you, Lloyd.
translation: 很适合你，Lloyd。

source: I guess it is better… But I still look like your secretary or something, Dar…
translation: 好像确实好多了……可我看起来还是像你的秘书之类的，Dar……

source: Yeah, Darius looks like he’s a mob boss or something!
translation: 是啊，Darius看起来像黑帮老大之类的！

source: He does look rather imposing… But in a good way…
translation: 他看起来确实很有压迫感……不过是好的那种……

source: Maybe if you wipe that blank look and smile more you’d be less intimidating?
translation: 也许你别总面无表情，多笑一笑，就不会那么吓人了？

source: No.
translation: 不要。

source: Try it, Dar! We wanna see!
translation: 试试看嘛，Dar！我们想看！

source: Oh… Well… I guess we can work on that one…
translation: 哦……好吧……看来这一点还得慢慢练……

source: There’s nothing wrong with Darius’ expressions! Honestly, his blank face is a lot more mysterious and attractive to some people!
translation: Darius的表情没有任何问题！说真的，他面无表情的样子对某些人来说反而更神秘、更有魅力！

source: I kind of like looking scary.
translation: 我有点喜欢自己看起来很吓人。

source: Maybe people will think twice before making fun of Lloyd’s bowtie.
translation: 这样别人在嘲笑Lloyd的领结前，就会三思。

source: You’re the one who made fun of it back in the room, Dar.
translation: 刚才在房间里嘲笑它的人明明就是你，Dar。

source: By the way, aren’t we missing someone from your group…?
translation: 对了，你们组里是不是还少了一个人……？

source: W-Wahh… I’m here! Sorry I’m late, guys…!
translation: 哇、哇啊……我来了！抱歉迟到了，各位……！

source: Whoa! Jin you look so… different!
translation: 哇！Jin，你看起来……完全不一样了！

source: Kyaaa!! Look at you! You look like a pop idol!
translation: 呀啊！！看看你！简直像个流行偶像！

source: Who knew that cutie Jin can look as handsome as this?
translation: 谁能想到可爱的Jin也能变得这么帅？

source: Jin already has a good-looking face to begin with. This just shows his full potential.
translation: Jin本来就长得好看。这只是展现出了他的全部潜力。

source: Hehehe… I really don’t groom myself at all… But thanks, you guys.
translation: 嘿嘿嘿……我平时真的完全不打扮……不过还是谢谢大家。

source: It’s about time you joined the party, Jin! When we left you were still in the shower!
translation: 你总算来参加聚会了，Jin！我们离开时你还在洗澡！

source: We were actually worried for a bit! You looked like you didn’t wanna come!
translation: 我们刚才还担心了一阵！你好像根本不想来！

source: S-Sorry… I take a long time to get ready… Especially for a special occasion…
translation: 抱、抱歉……我准备起来需要很久……尤其是这种特殊场合……

source: It’s rare that I attend events like this, and even rarer with a group of friends…
translation: 我很少参加这种活动，更别说和一群朋友一起……

source: Aww, are you still feeling nervous, Jin?
translation: 哎呀，你还在紧张吗，Jin？

source: A little bit, I only came because all of you were here.
translation: 有一点。我只是因为大家都在，才鼓起勇气来的。

source: Don’t worry, Jin. I’m sure all of us will have a good time tonight!
translation: 别担心，Jin。我相信大家今晚都会过得很开心！

source: Yeah… I’d like to be less of a shut-in. Especially when it comes to spending time with you guys.
translation: 是啊……我也想变得不那么宅。尤其是在和大家共度时光这件事上。

source: This is the perfect chance for me to—
translation: 这正是让我——

source: MAKE WAY! MAKE WAY! The queen of the night has arrived!
translation: 让开！让开！今晚的女王驾到！

source: Well?! Not even one compliment? I didn’t put on a lovely dress just to be ignored!
translation: 怎么样？！连一句赞美都没有吗？我穿上这么漂亮的裙子，可不是为了被忽视！

source: Y-You look stunning, Emilia…
translation: 你、你看起来美极了，Emilia……

source: *chuckles* I know~
translation: *轻笑* 我知道～

source: I was pleasantly surprised to find out Mr. Clermont arranged a fine dining experience for us tonight! Truly such a treat~!
translation: 得知Clermont先生今晚为我们安排了精致餐饮体验，我真是惊喜万分！实在太享受了～！

source: It’s been a hot minute since my last one! But better late than never!
translation: 我已经好一阵子没享受过了！不过迟到总比没有好！

source: You look wonderful, Ms. Komarova. But is this a different outfit than the one Mr. Clermont provided us?
translation: 您看起来很漂亮，Komarova小姐。不过这似乎不是Clermont先生为我们准备的那套衣服？

source: You have a good eye for luxury, Mr. Nomoru~ Of course I’ve brought my own attire!
translation: 您对奢侈品很有眼光，Nomoru先生～我当然带了自己的礼服！

source: Dress to impress, after all! I wouldn’t be caught dead wearing a free tacky dress, unlike someone~
translation: 毕竟穿衣就是要惊艳全场！我死也不会穿那种免费又俗气的裙子，不像某人～

source: Listen here, you—
translation: 你给我听着——

source: Would you like me to call for the staff to take your coat and your bag? Just so you’d be more comfortable before our meal.
translation: 要我叫工作人员来替您收走外套和包吗？这样用餐前您会更舒服。

source: No, thank you! Like they say, beauty is pain~
translation: 不用，谢谢！俗话说得好，美丽是要付出代价的～

source: The gown? Cucci! The feathers? Verse-ace! The shoes? Louis Butt-on! The jewelry? Stiffany & Ho!
translation: 礼服？Cucci！羽毛？Verse-ace！鞋子？Louis Butt-on！珠宝？Stiffany & Ho！

source: All custom made for me!
translation: 全都是为我量身定制的！

source: For the small price of two kidneys I bet.
translation: 我猜只花了两颗肾的小钱。

source: Hush, Yuri…!
translation: 嘘，Yuri……！

source: Teehee~ It’s no surprise anyone would be jealous. I mean… who wouldn’t be over someone like me?
translation: 嘻嘻～别人嫉妒也毫不奇怪。毕竟……面对我这种人，谁能不嫉妒呢？

source: Now! Where are we supposed to sit? Shouldn’t we be getting served right about now?
translation: 好了！我们该坐哪里？现在不该已经有人来招待了吗？

source: WAITER!
translation: 服务员！

source: You! Aren’t you gonna show us our table?! Don’t you know that we’re VIP guests here?!
translation: 你！还不带我们去座位？！难道不知道我们是这里的VIP客人吗？！

source: A-Ah… I was just waiting for you to gather up your party, madam…
translation: 啊、啊……女士，我只是在等您一行人全部到齐……

source: That should’ve been obvious upon my arrival! Now, show me to the best seat in here!
translation: 我一到这里，你就该明白人已经齐了！现在带我去这里最好的座位！

source: Reservations for Clermont Inc., yes? Right this way, everyone.
translation: 是Clermont公司的预约，对吧？各位，这边请。

source: *ehem*
translation: *咳咳*

source: Good evening, ladies and gentlemen! Welcome to The Glory Whole! My name is Reimond, and I will be taking care of you for the evening!
translation: 女士们、先生们，晚上好！欢迎来到“荣耀之洞”！我叫Reimond，今晚将由我为各位服务！

source: For tonight, we will be serving a three-course meal that includes an appetizer, a main, and a dessert!
translation: 今晚我们将提供三道式晚餐，包括开胃菜、主菜和甜点！

source: Take a look at our menu to see what we have for each course! Feel free to let us know if you have any specific requests and we’ll gladly prepare them for you!
