translation: 请查看菜单，了解每道菜的选择！如果有任何特殊要求，请尽管告诉我们，我们很乐意为您准备！

source: Meanwhile, please help yourselves to some freshly prepared complimentary snacks and beverages while the party decides on—
translation: 在各位决定点什么期间，请随意享用我们刚准备好的免费点心和饮品——

source: Why, there’s no need for that~ I’ve had plenty of experience with fine dining establishments, and I know exactly what I want!
translation: 哎呀，没那个必要～我在高级餐厅用餐经验丰富，很清楚自己想要什么！

source: For an appetizer, I’ll have the smoked salmon crostini with herbed mayo— Actually, hold the mayo, and use pesto instead~
translation: 开胃菜我要烟熏三文鱼意式烤面包，配香草蛋黄酱——其实不要蛋黄酱，换成青酱～

source: For the main course, give me the petit beef wellington, obviously it had better be made with filet mignon and hand-kneaded puff pastry.
translation: 主菜给我小份惠灵顿牛排，当然最好用菲力牛排和手工揉制的酥皮。

source: Medium RARE, oh, and don’t overdo it. Trust me, I’ll know.
translation: 三分熟，还有，千万别做过头。相信我，我吃得出来。

source: Lastly, for dessert… I’ll keep it simple. I’ll have a vanilla crème brulee topped with fresh blueberries and a dash of raspberry coulis.
translation: 最后是甜点……简单一点。我要香草焦糖布蕾，上面放新鲜蓝莓，再淋少许覆盆子酱。

source: Very fine choice, madam. I’ll make sure everything is carefully prepared to your liking.
translation: 非常出色的选择，女士。我会确保每一道都严格按照您的喜好精心准备。

source: Does everyone else have their order ready as well?
translation: 其他各位也准备好点单了吗？

source: Ah, not yet. Can you give us a little bit more time to browse the menu?
translation: 啊，还没有。能再给我们一点时间看看菜单吗？

source: Of course! Take your time!
translation: 当然！请慢慢挑选！

source: First timers, am I right?
translation: 第一次来高级餐厅，对吧？

source: In the meantime, I shall relay madam’s order to our chef. I’ll be back soon to take the rest of your orders!
translation: 与此同时，我先把这位女士的订单转达给主厨。很快回来为其余各位点单！

source: Gee… Everything in this menu sounds like gibberish to me… even with all the descriptions, I can’t tell how it’ll taste…
translation: 天啊……这份菜单里的东西对我来说都像天书……就算有说明，我也想象不出是什么味道……

source: Honestly I can’t even pronounce some of this… Like this booyah…boys?
translation: 说实话，有些词我连读都不会……比如这个布亚……男孩？

source: That’s bouillabaisse my dear, it’s a good thing I’m here. If anyone needs help with the menu, I don’t mind educating you~
translation: 亲爱的，那叫马赛鱼汤，幸好我在这里。如果有人看不懂菜单，我不介意教教你们～

source: Oh, let’s ask Aiden about it! He knows a lot about food!
translation: 哦，我们问Aiden吧！他很懂食物！

source: Ask the chef directly. Good idea.
translation: 直接问厨师。好主意。

source: Ahh… Well… I haven’t really heard of most of these, but I recognize some of them from my dad’s cookbook…
translation: 啊……这个嘛……大多数我都没听过，但有几样我在爸爸的食谱里见过……

source: I’d like something fresh! What about foie gras? That sounds greeny!
translation: 我想吃点新鲜清爽的！鹅肝怎么样？听起来很绿色健康！

source: I think you read that as grass…
translation: 我想你把它看成“草”了……

source: Uhh… That’s duck liver, Lloyd… I think…
translation: 呃……那是鸭肝，Lloyd……我想是的……

source: Blech! No thanks, then!
translation: 呸！那还是算了！

source: W-Well, you can have some fish for your main if you want something lighter…
translation: 这、这个嘛，如果想吃清淡一点，主菜可以点鱼……

source: Oh! The seafood menu has a lot of fancy sounding ones! Should I get the ceviche? The quenelle? Or the acqua pazza?
translation: 哦！海鲜菜单上有好多听起来很高级的菜！我该点酸橘汁腌鱼、法式鱼肉丸，还是意式水煮鱼？

source: Uhh… I-I’m not sure what kind of fish is used in any of those…
translation: 呃……我、我不确定这些菜分别用了什么鱼……

source: I guess I’ll just order the longest-spelled one!
translation: 那我就点名字最长的那个吧！

source: For Dar, which one of these is spicy?
translation: 给Dar的话，这里面哪一道是辣的？

source: Maybe try the… uhh… korma?
translation: 也许可以试试……呃……库尔玛咖喱？

source: Sounds good.
translation: 听起来不错。

source: Ooh! Aiden, should we get coq au vin? That sounds juicy~
translation: 哦！Aiden，我们要不要点红酒炖鸡？听起来汁水很多～

source: I, uh… don’t know what that is…
translation: 我，呃……不知道那是什么……

source: This menu description says it’s chicken cooked in red wine. That should be good enough.
translation: 菜单上说是用红酒炖的鸡肉。听起来应该不错。

source: What should we get for the appetizers and dessert then?
translation: 那开胃菜和甜点该点什么？

source: I… I feel bad, I really don’t know what to get… even with the descriptions listed…
translation: 我……我很抱歉，真的不知道该点什么……即使菜单上写了说明……

source: Aiden knows for sure what’s good just by looking at the ingredients!
translation: Aiden只要看看配料，肯定就知道什么好吃！

source: Ah, yes. If you don’t mind, Aiden, can you pick the meal courses for us? I trust your recommendations.
translation: 啊，对。如果你不介意，Aiden，能替我们选一套菜吗？我相信你的推荐。

source: Uhh… G-Gimme a sec.
translation: 呃……给、给我一点时间。

source: Umm, everyone? Maybe let’s just order something we’re all more familiar with?
translation: 嗯，各位？也许我们还是点些大家比较熟悉的东西？

source: I-It’s alright, Yoshi! I know some of these…!
translation: 没、没关系，Yoshi！这里面有些我认识……！

source: This one should be good, you guys…! Everyone likes bacon and cheese, right? Then something fruity for dessert?
translation: 这一道应该不错，各位……！大家都喜欢培根和奶酪，对吧？甜点再选个水果味的？

source: That settles it then.
translation: 那就这么定了。

source: What about you, Aiden? Have you picked one for your main yet? I’ll have whatever you’re having.
translation: 你呢，Aiden？主菜选好了吗？你点什么我就点什么。

source: Oh…! I was just planning to get some porkchops with gravy, you like that too, right?
translation: 哦……！我正打算点猪排配肉汁，你也喜欢吧？

source: Pardon my intrusion, but I can’t help but overhear your selections… Wouldn’t it be such a wasted opportunity to order something so basic?
translation: 恕我冒昧，但我无意间听到了你们的选择……难得有这种机会，却点这么普通的菜，不是太浪费了吗？

source: For someone labeled as a chef, you seem to have a simple palette.
translation: 对于一个被称作厨师的人来说，你的味觉似乎过于简单。

source: I’m sure chances to experience high-class meals are once in a blue moon for you, so why not try something new for once to elevate yours and everyone’s taste level?
translation: 我相信你很少有机会体验高级餐饮，何不偶尔尝试点新东西，提升你和大家的品味？

source: Luckily, I’m in such a good mood today, so I don’t mind offering some suggestions~
translation: 幸好我今天心情很好，所以不介意给你们一些建议～

source: For the main, the superior choice is obviously the slow roasted pork belly~ Flavorful and hearty.
translation: 主菜显然该选慢烤五花肉～味道浓郁又丰盛。

source: Sounds more like a heart attack.
translation: 听起来更像心脏病套餐。

source: Yuri, behave.
translation: Yuri，注意礼貌。

source: Mr. Sirius, if you prefer seafood with a higher price point, then the choice for you is lobster bisque! Black truffle dal for Mr. Najjar. And saffron chicken paella for everyone else~
translation: Sirius先生，如果您偏爱价格更高的海鲜，那就选龙虾浓汤！Najjar先生选黑松露扁豆咖喱。其他人则点藏红花鸡肉西班牙海鲜饭～

source: As for the appetizers—
translation: 至于开胃菜——

source: It’s alright, Emilia. We’re good with our orders.
translation: 不用了，Emilia。我们已经选好了。

source: Hmph. Suit yourselves, then!
translation: 哼。那就随你们便！

source: Hello, has everyone decided on their orders?
translation: 各位好，都决定好要点什么了吗？

source: Ah, yes! Here they are!
translation: 啊，是的！都在这里！

source: Perfect! I’ll relay these to our chef!
translation: 太好了！我会把订单转交给主厨！

source: Is it just me, or is everyone else really excited too?
translation: 是只有我这样，还是大家也都很兴奋？

source: I-I am. I’ve never been to fine dining before…
translation: 我、我很兴奋。我以前从没吃过高级餐饮……

source: Hihi~ It’ll be a big leap compared to your instant-noodle diet.
translation: 嘻嘻～和你平时的方便面饮食相比，这可是巨大飞跃。

source: I was actually curious, so I looked this restaurant up online before I got here… and it’s crazy how the food looked like art on a plate…
translation: 其实我很好奇，所以来之前在网上查了这家餐厅……那些食物摆在盘子里简直像艺术品一样，太夸张了……

source: Spoiler alert.
translation: 你剧透了。

source: Oh boy! I can’t wait to see what we ordered then!
translation: 天啊！那我等不及想看看我们点的菜了！

source: This place also had complete five-out-of-five star positive reviews…
translation: 而且这家餐厅得到的全都是五星满分好评……

source: That’s quite a feat considering how expensive the price point here is…
translation: 考虑到这里的价位有多高，这可是相当了不起的成绩……

source: Fancy doesn’t always mean good food! So, we’ll be the judge of that!
translation: 高级可不一定代表食物好吃！所以要由我们来判断！

source: We have pretty high standards when it comes to taste, all thanks to Aiden’s cooking~
translation: 多亏Aiden的厨艺，我们对味道的标准可是很高的～

source: That’s true. What Aiden makes back at camp sure is better than anything I get when I eat out.
translation: 确实。Aiden在营地做的饭，比我在外面吃到的任何东西都好。

source: Ahehe… M-Maybe you guys just got too used to my cooking…
translation: 啊嘿嘿……也、也许你们只是太习惯我做的饭了……

source: For real though, Aiden. We wouldn’t always be looking forward to mealtimes if not for your cooking!
translation: 不过说真的，Aiden。要不是你的厨艺，我们才不会总期待着吃饭时间！

source: I beg to differ. A restaurant this high-caliber would definitely deliver more sophistication than just plain pork and beans.
translation: 恕我不能苟同。这种高档餐厅肯定比普通的猪肉炖豆子精致得多。

source: You mean the same pork and beans I always see you lick clean off your plate?
translation: 你是说我总看到你把盘子舔得干干净净的那种猪肉炖豆子？

source: Why— There’s no way I’d behave with such disgusting table manners, even more so over commoner’s grub!
translation: 什——我绝不可能做出如此恶心的餐桌举止，更不可能是为了平民饭菜！

source: I dunnoooo... You’re always the first one to arrive at the mess hall every morning too…
translation: 谁知道呢——……你每天早上也总是第一个到食堂……

source: Can confirm.
translation: 我可以作证。

source: Of course, I have to make sure and be the first one up as the inspector! Don’t twist my actions into something else to fit your narrative.
translation: 当然了，身为检查员，我必须确保第一个起床！别为了配合你们的说辞，歪曲我的行为。

source: I guess we’re all trying to say you like Aiden’s cooking too. There’s no shame in admitting that, right…?
translation: 我想大家只是想说，你也喜欢Aiden做的饭。承认这一点并不丢脸，对吧……？

source: Serving the first course!
translation: 第一道菜来了！

source: A-About time…!
translation: 总、总算来了……！

source: Please enjoy! And call me if you need anything!
translation: 请慢用！有任何需要都可以叫我！

source: This is it?!
translation: 就这？！

source: T-The portions are kinda small, aren’t they…?
translation: 分、分量是不是有点小……？

source: I swear I thought it was something like pizza…
translation: 我发誓，我还以为会是披萨之类的……

source: Uh… What’s going on? Are we being pranked…?
translation: 呃……这是怎么回事？有人在整我们吗……？

source: *ehem* Everyone, this is just the—
translation: *咳咳* 各位，这只是——

source: Simpletons! These are just the appetizers! They’re supposed to be small!
translation: 一群没见识的家伙！这些只是开胃菜！本来就应该很小！

source: Oh, well I’m done eating it. That just made me hungrier.
translation: 哦，好吧，我已经吃完了。结果反而更饿。

source: That’s the point! It’s meant to stimulate your senses, to build up your appetite for the main course!
translation: 这正是目的！它是用来刺激感官，为主菜吊起胃口的！

source: I really thought it’d be bigger than just one-bite.
translation: 我真以为它至少不会只有一口那么大。

source: Did you really think they’d serve pizza in a place like this? You really are out of touch!
translation: 你真以为这种地方会端上披萨？你真是毫无常识！

source: And you’re not supposed to shove it down your throat and swallow it like a pill! You’re ruining the experience!
translation: 而且你不该把它塞进喉咙，像吞药片一样咽下去！你把整个体验都毁了！

source: Look at how it’s done! I sliced mine into four equal parts, making sure each part has every ingredient, allowing me to savor each bite!
translation: 看看正确吃法！我把它切成大小相等的四份，确保每一份都有全部配料，这样才能细细品味每一口！

source: If only everyone had listened to my recommendations, then you wouldn’t have missed out~
translation: 要是大家都听了我的建议，就不会错过好东西了～

source: S-Sorry, guys... I guess I made a mistake with the order.
translation: 抱、抱歉，各位……看来我点错了。

source: It’s fine, Aiden. This is a new experience for all of us.
translation: 没关系，Aiden。这对我们所有人来说都是全新的体验。

source: I hope everyone enjoyed their appetizers, as the main course is ready! Please enjoy!
translation: 希望各位喜欢开胃菜，主菜已经准备好了！请慢用！

source: Now we’re talking! My mouth is watering from just looking at it!
translation: 这才像话！光是看着我就流口水了！

source: KYAA~! Talk about the plating and presentation!
translation: 呀啊～！这摆盘和造型也太漂亮了！

source: I wish I’d brought my camera to take a picture of this…
translation: 真希望我带了相机，可以把它拍下来……

source: We’ll let’s see if it tastes as good as it looks.
translation: 好吧，来尝尝味道是不是和外观一样好。

source: Mmm… It’s delicious! It’s almost as good as yours, Aiden!
translation: 嗯……真好吃！几乎和你做的一样好，Aiden！

source: Oh… This is way better, though.
translation: 哦……不过这个好吃多了。

source: Melts in my mouth.
translation: 入口即化。

source: You should recreate this sometime, Aiden!
translation: Aiden，你以后应该试着重现这道菜！

source: That’s a great idea! It’d be nice to have our own fancy dining experience back at camp every now and then!
translation: 好主意！偶尔在营地里也来一次属于我们的高级餐饮体验，一定很棒！

source: I’d like that.
translation: 我会喜欢的。

source: Uhh… I don’t think I could even if I tried… I can’t even figure out what they used to make these flavors.
translation: 呃……我觉得就算努力也做不出来……我连他们用了什么调出这些味道都弄不明白。

source: The taste does seem kind of complex, huh? It’s a totally different style from yours.
translation: 味道确实很复杂，对吧？和你的风格完全不同。

source: Oh, I’m sure Aiden can do it! He’s made everything from burgers to steaks!
translation: 哦，我相信Aiden能做到！从汉堡到牛排，他什么都做过！

source: Not with those horrible table manners, he can’t.
translation: 凭他那糟糕的餐桌礼仪，不可能。

source: I mean… He’s using his dessert spoon for the main course, his elbows are on the table, and I can hear his chewing from over here!
translation: 我是说……他用甜点勺吃主菜，手肘放在桌上，而且我坐这里都能听到他的咀嚼声！

source: What does that have to do with anything?
translation: 这和厨艺有什么关系？

source: I thought we were talking about cooking…
translation: 我以为我们在聊烹饪……

source: It’s unrealistic to expect a homecook to replicate a dish like this if he’s not even aware of basic dining etiquette.
translation: 如果一个家庭厨师连基本用餐礼仪都不懂，指望他复刻这种菜根本不现实。

source: Professionals have spent years in culinary school studying and mastering the craft.
translation: 专业人士要在烹饪学校学习多年，才能掌握这门技艺。

source: I wouldn’t say that Aiden doesn’t have the experience – he’s been the chef at Camp Buddy for years now.
translation: 我不会说Aiden缺乏经验——他已经在伙伴营当了好几年厨师。

source: Not only that, but he comes from a family of excellent cooks as well.
translation: 不仅如此，他还出身于一个厨艺精湛的家庭。

source: W-We do know how to cook, but it’s definitely not anything like this…
translation: 我、我们确实会做饭，但绝对不是这种水平……

source: See? He said it himself.
translation: 看吧？他自己都这么说。

source: It’s honestly quite a stretch to claim that bloodline has anything to do with technical skills like culinary arts.
translation: 说血统与烹饪这种技术能力有关，实在太牵强了。

source: Aren’t you the one who always brags about your family background when it has nothing to do with your skills whatsoever?
translation: 你不是总拿自己的家世吹嘘吗？可那和你的能力根本毫无关系。

source: I bet you can’t even fry an egg.
translation: 我赌你连鸡蛋都不会煎。

source: C-Can’t we just enjoy the meal…?
translation: 我、我们就不能好好享用这顿饭吗……？

source: No, no. Let’s talk about it, since she’s questioning my abilities.
translation: 不，不。既然她在质疑我的能力，那就好好谈谈。

source: I think I’ve proven how skilled I am over the last few months with actual results.
translation: 过去几个月里，我已经用实际成果证明了自己的能力。

source: Without me, your whole project wouldn’t have gotten this far, and we wouldn’t be sitting here enjoying this lovely dinner.
translation: 没有我，你们整个项目根本走不到今天，我们也不会坐在这里享用这顿美好晚餐。

source: I didn’t see you lift a finger to help any of the departments the entire time…
translation: 这段时间我没见你动一根手指帮助任何部门……

source: You’re just micro-managing.
translation: 你只会事无巨细地指手画脚。

source: I cannot believe what I’m hearing! You’re all just trying to discredit me, just like you did in that meeting!
translation: 真不敢相信我听到了什么！你们只是在贬低我的功劳，就像那次会议上一样！

source: If anything, all of you just can’t accept honest criticism!
translation: 说到底，你们所有人都无法接受坦率的批评！

source: Emilia, stop!
translation: Emilia，住口！

source: It’s awfully convenient for all of you to point at me for your own shortcomings, isn’t it?
translation: 把自己的缺点全都怪到我头上，对你们来说可真方便，不是吗？

source: What about Mr. Scoutmaster Chef here who lacks any sort of professionalism?!
translation: 那这位毫无专业素养的童子军长兼厨师先生又怎么说？！

source: You all let him get away with basically anything as if he wasn’t carrying the camp’s reputation with him!
translation: 你们几乎纵容他做任何事，就好像他不代表营地的声誉一样！

source: Why, even here at an all-expense paid luxury resort, he lacks the dignity to not cause a commotion!
translation: 就连在这个费用全包的豪华度假村里，他也毫无体面可言，照样闹出乱子！

source: He humiliated your beloved camp, putting the sponsorship at risk, by getting drunk and once again flaunting his obscenity in a public place!
translation: 他喝得烂醉，再次在公共场合展示下流部位，让你们心爱的营地蒙羞，还把赞助置于风险之中！

source: Not only that, but he has zero credentials and no formal training whatsoever to be in a position of leadership!
translation: 不仅如此，他没有任何资质，也没接受过正规训练，根本没资格担任领导职务！

source: It’s really absurd that you all continue to humor this beggar and claim that he’s of such great value!
translation: 你们还继续迁就这个乞丐，声称他多么有价值，实在荒唐！

source: What did you just call him?!
translation: 你刚才叫他什么？！

source: This is where I really draw the line, Emilia!
translation: 这次你真的越过我的底线了，Emilia！

source: Why do you keep trying to bring Aiden down?!
translation: 你为什么总想贬低Aiden？！

source: Y-Yoshi, don’t—
translation: 义、Yoshi，别——

source: When are you going to accept that he’s just as good a scoutmaster as the rest of us?!
translation: 你什么时候才肯承认，他和我们其他人一样，都是优秀的童子军长？！

source: There’s no way I’m going to let you trash him when you refuse to acknowledge the fact that he works the hardest out of everyone here!
translation: 他明明是这里最努力的人，你却拒绝承认，我绝不会任由你这样侮辱他！

source: You won’t even consider the facts I’m stating! You’re just proving my point about how you ALWAYS cover for him!
translation: 你连我陈述的事实都不肯考虑！这恰好证明了我的观点——你永远都在袒护他！

source: If you want to keep feeding him false hope, then by all means! Let him live with all your pathetic lies!
translation: 如果你想继续给他虚假的希望，那就请便！让他活在你那些可悲的谎言里吧！

source: No wonder he sticks around you so much, all you ever do is make him believe he belongs somewhere he never deserved to be!
translation: 难怪他总黏着你，你只会让他相信自己属于一个他从来不配待的地方！

source: Shut the hell up, Emilia! You know nothing about Aiden!
translation: 给我闭嘴，Emilia！你根本不了解Aiden！

source: I won’t let you keep disrespecting him like this!
translation: 我不会再让你这样羞辱他！

source: Take a good look at yourself and tell me who’s actually incompetent here!
translation: 好好看看你自己，然后告诉我这里真正无能的人是谁！

source: {i}(Crap… I got carried away and let my anger get the best of me with Emilia…){/i}
translation: {i}（糟糕……我太冲动了，在Emilia面前被愤怒冲昏了头……）{/i}

source: {i}(All that did was make Aiden extremely anxious… I can almost feel him shaking nervously from my seat…){/i}
translation: {i}（这样只会让Aiden极度焦虑……坐在这里，我几乎都能感觉到他在紧张地发抖……）{/i}

source: {i}(All that did was make Aiden extremely anxious… I can almost feel him shaking nervously from my seat…){/i}{fast}
translation: {i}（这样只会让Aiden极度焦虑……坐在这里，我几乎都能感觉到他在紧张地发抖……）{/i}{fast}

source: Stay silent.
translation: 保持沉默。

source: {i}(I’d better just stay quiet… I don’t want to make this any worse…){/i}
translation: {i}（我最好还是保持安静……我不想让事情变得更糟……）{/i}

source: Waiter!
translation: 服务员！

source: Is everything okay over here, sir?
translation: 先生，这边一切都还好吗？

source: Yes. Could you please get us wine for the table?
translation: 很好。麻烦给我们这桌拿些葡萄酒来好吗？

source: Of course, sir! Which would you prefer, red, white, or sparkling?
translation: 当然，先生！您喜欢红葡萄酒、白葡萄酒，还是起泡酒？

source: Red would be excellent. Give us the best one.
translation: 红葡萄酒很好。给我们上最好的一瓶。

source: Good choice, sir! I’ll be back in just a moment!
translation: 好选择，先生！我马上回来！

source: {i}(It looks like Sir Goro’s trying to defuse the situation…){/i}
translation: {i}（看来Goro先生正试图缓和局面……）{/i}

source: Apologize.
translation: 道歉。

source: *ehem* I-I suppose I took that too far... I apologize, everyone.
translation: *咳咳* 我、我想自己确实说得太过分了……向大家道歉。

source: As well you should! I can’t believe you—
translation: 你当然该道歉！真不敢相信你——

source: Take Aiden away.
translation: 带Aiden离开。

source: Aiden, come with me. Let’s go back to our room for the night.
translation: Aiden，跟我来。今晚我们回房间吧。

source: W-We don’t have to do that, Yoshi! Let’s just get a drink to calm everyone down.
translation: 我、我们不用走，Yoshi！喝点酒，让大家冷静下来就好。

source: Alright, if you’re sure…
translation: 好吧，既然你确定……

source: Excuse me, waiter?
translation: 打扰一下，服务员？

source: Yes, sir? Is everything alright?
translation: 先生？一切都还好吗？

source: Y-Yes, of course… We’d just like to order a bottle of wine!
translation: 是、是的，当然……我们只是想点一瓶葡萄酒！

source: {i}(Thank goodness Sir Goro stepped in to help… I just wanted a distraction from that situation…){/i}
translation: {i}（幸好Goro先生出面帮忙……我只想找点事情转移大家对刚才局面的注意……）{/i}

source: Call for distraction.
translation: 叫人来转移注意。

source: *ehem* Waiter!
translation: *咳咳* 服务员！

source: {i}(This is so awkward… Everyone’s extra tense from that argument…){/i}
translation: {i}（太尴尬了……刚才那场争吵让每个人都格外紧张……）{/i}

source: {i}(I’m afraid that Aiden must be blaming himself for this…){/i}
translation: {i}（恐怕Aiden一定在为这件事责怪自己……）{/i}

source: Here you are, a vintage Cabernet Sauvignon! Allow me to serve the party—
translation: 酒来了，这是一瓶陈年赤霞珠！请允许我为各位斟酒——

source: Thanks, but that won’t be necessary. We’ll pour it ourselves.
translation: 谢谢，不过不必了。我们自己来倒。

source: Of course. Call me if you need anything else.
translation: 当然。有其他需要请随时叫我。

source: Here, Aiden. Why don’t I pour you some wine?
translation: 来，Aiden。我给你倒点酒吧？

source: I-It’s alright, Yoshi…! I can do it…!
translation: 没、没关系，Yoshi……！我自己来……！

source: It’s okay, Aiden. Just hand me your glass!
translation: 没事的，Aiden。把杯子递给我！

source: N-No, it’s really okay, let me—
translation: 不、不，真的没关系，让我——

source: G-Gah!
translation: 嘎、嘎啊！

source: A-Aiden….!
translation: 艾、Aiden……！

source: Oh dear, and it’s all over that fine suit of yours – no, wait, that belongs to Mr. Clermont, doesn’t it?
translation: 哦，天哪，全洒在你那套漂亮西装上了——不，等等，那是Clermont先生的衣服，对吧？

source: I-It’s alright, I can just wipe it up with my napkin and—
translation: 没、没关系，我用餐巾擦干净就——

source: S-Shit, hold on, let me get that—
translation: 该、该死，等等，让我来擦——

source: I-It’s alright, Aiden! Calm down.
translation: 没、没事的，Aiden！冷静下来。

source: A-Ah, people are starting to stare…
translation: 啊、啊，其他人开始盯着我们了……

source: I-I’ll just go clean up…! B-Be right back…!
translation: 我、我去清理一下……！马、马上回来……！

source: I heard a commotion, is everything—
translation: 我听到了动静，一切都——

source: Whoa!
translation: 哇！

source: G-Gah…! I-I’m so sorry!
translation: 嘎、嘎啊……！非、非常抱歉！

source: I-I have to go…!
translation: 我、我得走了……！

source: A-Aiden! Wait!
translation: 艾、Aiden！等等！

source: I’m sorry about that. Let me help you out.
translation: 对此我很抱歉。让我帮您处理。

source: I-It’s quite alright and thank you.
translation: 没、没关系，谢谢您。

source: *sips* Well, that’s something you don’t see every day~
translation: *抿一口* 好吧，这可不是每天都能看到的场面～

source: Grr…
Are Aiden and Yoshi alright…? Should we go after them…?
translation: Aiden和Yoshi没事吧……？我们该追过去吗……？

source: They’ll be fine. Aiden just got overwhelmed.
translation: 他们不会有事。Aiden只是承受不住了。

source: I’m getting anxious… People are whispering and staring at us…
translation: 我开始焦虑了……大家都在窃窃私语，盯着我们看……

source: Well, maybe all of you shouldn’t have been so rude, then none of this would’ve happened.
translation: 这个嘛，也许你们所有人一开始就不该那么无礼，那这一切都不会发生。

source: ALL OF US?! You’re the only one who’s been rude this whole time!!
translation: 我们所有人？！从头到尾唯一无礼的人就是你！！

source: You’re rotten to the core just like you were back then!
translation: 你和当年一样，从骨子里就烂透了！

source: Step off that putrid high horse and get away from Camp Buddy already!
translation: 别再摆出那副恶臭的高高在上姿态，赶紧离开伙伴营！

source: You don’t belong with us, and you never will!
translation: 你不属于我们，永远都不会！

source: That’s enough!
translation: 够了！

source: W-Why, I can’t believe you’re letting her humiliate me like this ag—
translation: 为、为什么，我不敢相信你竟然又让她这样羞辱我——

source: I said enough. We don’t need to hear anything else, especially from you Ms. Komarova.
translation: 我说够了。我们不需要再听任何话，尤其是你的，Komarova小姐。

source: This dinner is over. All of you, back to your rooms.
translation: 晚宴到此结束。所有人都回房间。

source: Aiden—
translation: Aiden——

source: …I’m sure I saw him come in here.
translation: ……我确定看到他进了这里。

source: A-Are you in there, Aiden…?
translation: 艾、Aiden，你在里面吗……？

source: Y-Yeah, Yoshi…!
translation: 在、在的，Yoshi……！

source: Are you alright in there? You didn’t get hurt from that fall, did you?
translation: 你在里面没事吧？刚才摔倒没有受伤吧？

source: I-I’m fine…! I’m just washing the stain off this suit…!
translation: 我、我没事……！只是在洗掉西装上的污渍……！

source: Oh…
Y-You should go back to everyone… They’re waiting for you back there.
translation: 你、你应该回到大家那里……他们还在等你。

source: But I need to know for sure you’re alright…
translation: 但我得确定你真的没事……

source: I’m totally alright, Yoshi…!
translation: 我完全没事，Yoshi……！

source: I-I really don’t wanna ruin this suit… I don’t have the money to pay for something like this…
translation: 我、我真的不想毁掉这套西装……这种东西我根本赔不起……

source: T-That’s not really important, Aiden… I’m sure Mr. Clermont won’t mind.
translation: 那、那并不重要，Aiden……我相信Clermont先生不会介意。

source: And it’s not too late to go back to everyone, they’ll understand for sure.
translation: 而且现在回到大家那里还不晚，他们一定会理解。

source: I-I’d really rather stay here, Yoshi… It’s really not a big deal, and I don’t want everyone to worry…
translation: 我、我真的更想待在这里，Yoshi……这没什么大不了的，我也不想让大家担心……

source: I-I’d really rather stay here, Yoshi… It’s really not a big deal, and I don’t want everyone to worry…{fast}
translation: 我、我真的更想待在这里，Yoshi……这没什么大不了的，我也不想让大家担心……{fast}

source: I won't go without you.
translation: 没有你，我不会走。

source: I won’t go without you.
translation: 没有你，我不会走。

source: Khh…
Aiden, please…
translation: Aiden，求你了……

source: Can we at least talk…?
translation: 至少让我们谈谈，好吗……？

source: Open the door.
translation: 把门打开。

source: Just open the door, Aiden.
translation: 把门打开吧，Aiden。

source: Kkh…!!
I'm staying here.
translation: 我要留在这里。

source: I’m staying here with you.
translation: 我要留在这里陪你。

source: But you're not okay.
translation: 但你的状态并不好。

source: You’re not okay, Aiden.
translation: 你的状态并不好，Aiden。

source: I’m worried about you more than everyone else.
translation: 比起其他人，我更担心你。

source: {i}(For all the time I’ve known Aiden, I’ve never seen him get into his head this badly…){/i}
translation: {i}（认识Aiden这么久，我从没见他陷入如此严重的自我怀疑……）{/i}

source: {i}(He can’t stop fidgeting, and I can see him breaking into a cold sweat…){/i}
translation: {i}（他不停地坐立不安，我能看见他开始冒冷汗……）{/i}

source: Aiden, tell me what’s on your mind…
translation: Aiden，告诉我你在想什么……

source: I… I don’t want to be here anymore, Yoshi…
translation: 我……我不想再待在这里了，Yoshi……

source: It’s been so hard to pretend that I’m comfortable with everything, when I know I don’t really belong in a place like this…
translation: 明知道自己根本不属于这种地方，却还要假装一切都很自在，真的太难了……

source: I just… want to go home…
translation: 我只是……想回家……

source: Today’s our last night here, Aiden… Just hold on for a little longer…
translation: 今晚已经是我们在这里的最后一晚了，Aiden……再坚持一下……

source: Everything will go back to the way it was once we get back to camp tomorrow…
translation: 明天回到营地后，一切都会恢复原样……

source: I know, but… I just can’t help but feel guilty the whole time we were here…
translation: 我知道，可是……我们待在这里的整段时间，我都忍不住感到愧疚……

source: You were doing everything you could to watch out for me ’cause I had trouble keeping up.
translation: 因为我跟不上，你一直竭尽全力照顾我。

source: It’s almost as if I’ve been dragging you down and keeping you from enjoying this trip…
translation: 感觉我一直在拖你的后腿，害你无法享受这趟旅行……

source: But I had a great time spending this vacation with you, Aiden…!
translation: 可和你一起度过这次假期，我真的很开心，Aiden……！

source: I know it hasn’t been easy for you, but at the very least you tried your best to have fun with me and everyone else…
translation: 我知道这对你并不容易，但至少你尽了最大努力，和我还有大家一起享受旅程……

source: And I was so close to getting through it, then I just had to go and screw it up at the last moment…
translation: 我明明差一点就坚持到最后，却偏偏在最后关头把一切搞砸了……

source: What happened back there at the dinner wasn’t your fault at all though, Aiden.
translation: 但晚宴上发生的事完全不是你的错，Aiden。

source: If anything, Emilia’s the one who’s been causing trouble ever since she showed up.
translation: 真要说的话，从Emilia出现开始，惹麻烦的人一直都是她。

source: Whenever she doesn’t get her way, she tends to say horrible things about you for no reason…
translation: 每当事情不如她意，她总会毫无理由地对你说那些恶毒的话……

source: As awful as everything Emilia said about me back there was… She was right.
translation: 虽然Emilia刚才说我的那些话非常恶毒……但她说得没错。

source: A-About what…?
translation: 哪、哪一点……？

source: I’m not worth anything…
translation: 我一文不值……

source: And the only reason I’m here is because of you…
translation: 而我能站在这里，唯一的原因就是你……

source: Let’s be honest… I’m a nobody. It’s what I always was from the start…
translation: 说实话吧……我只是个无名小卒。从一开始，我就一直是这样……

source: I’m poor as dirt, I’m not educated, I have no actual skills… I’m nothing.
translation: 我穷得叮当响，没受过教育，也没有任何真正的技能……我什么都不是。

source: Don’t let Emilia’s words get to you, Aiden! You know that’s not true…!
translation: 别让Emilia的话影响你，Aiden！你知道那不是真的……！

source: But it is, Yoshi! I would’ve screwed up on the project if you hadn’t covered for me this whole time!
translation: 可那就是真的，Yoshi！要不是你一直替我兜底，我早就把项目搞砸了！

source: You could have someone take my job at any time, and nothing would change!
translation: 你随时都可以找个人顶替我的工作，一切都不会有任何变化！

source: But you’re so much more than that, Aiden! You’re—
translation: 可你远不止这些，Aiden！你是——

source: Didn’t you see me back there? I didn’t know how to answer everyone’s questions about the only thing I’m supposed to be good at!
translation: 你刚才没看到我吗？面对大家关于我唯一擅长之事的提问，我都不知道该怎么回答！

source: Heck, I can’t even hold the right spoon or pour a glass of wine!
translation: 该死，我甚至不会拿对勺子，也倒不好一杯葡萄酒！

source: I’m a fucking joke for believing that I had something special I could do…!
translation: 我居然相信自己有某种特别的本事，真他妈是个笑话……！

source: It was the only thing I could do to make you proud of me...
translation: 那是我唯一能让你为我感到骄傲的事……

source: The reality is I was never meant for anything great in the first place.
translation: 现实是，我从一开始就注定成不了什么大事。

source: I just can’t deny it anymore. That all I’ve always been was a burden and a disappointment…
translation: 我再也无法否认，我一直都只是个负担，只会让人失望……

source: I’ve never thought of you that way…! Not even once!
translation: 我从来没那样看过你……！一次都没有！

source: Even right now, you’re staying here, missing out because I can’t pull my shit together...!
translation: 就连现在，你也因为我无法振作起来而留在这里，错过了晚宴……！

source: That’s because I want to be here for you, Aiden…! More than anything else!
translation: 那是因为我想陪在你身边，Aiden……！这比任何事都重要！

source: You’re just wasting your time on me, there’s nothing I can pay you back with…
translation: 你只是在我身上浪费时间，我根本没有任何东西可以回报你……

source: I cause nothing but trouble to everyone, especially you, Yoshi…
translation: 我只会给大家惹麻烦，尤其是给你，Yoshi……

source: What about all those years you’ve spent helping me and the camp…? Do you really believe we’d have gotten this far without you?
translation: 那你这么多年来对我和营地的帮助呢……？你真觉得没有你，我们能走到今天吗？

source: Out of everyone, you were the only one we could always rely on! Whether you were a scoutmaster or not, you’ve always done your best and given it your all!
translation: 在所有人中，只有你一直值得我们依靠！无论你是不是童子军长，你始终竭尽所能，全力以赴！

source: Yoshi… Please, stop sugarcoating everything for me when we both know the truth…
translation: Yoshi……求你别再粉饰一切了，我们都知道真相……

source: The truth is that everything I have so far is because of pity…
translation: 真相是，我至今拥有的一切全都来自别人的怜悯……

source: My Dad and I were hired to work at Camp Buddy out of pity… I’ve become a scoutmaster out of pity… Everyone treated me nicely, all because of pity…
translation: 我和爸爸因为别人的怜悯才被伙伴营雇用……我因为怜悯才当上童子军长……大家对我好，也全都是因为怜悯……

source: Even you… That’s how you’ve always seen me…
translation: 就连你也一样……你一直都是这样看我的……

source: Even you… That’s how you’ve always seen me…{fast}
translation: 就连你也一样……你一直都是这样看我的……{fast}

source: Don't put words in my mouth!
translation: 别替我说话！

source: Don’t put words in my mouth, Aiden!
translation: 别擅自曲解我的想法，Aiden！

source: How could you think that?!
translation: 你怎么会这么想？！

source: How could you think that after all we’ve been through, Aiden?!
translation: 经历了这么多以后，你怎么还能这么想，Aiden？！

source: It's the opposite!
translation: 事实正好相反！

source: Pity is the exact opposite of what I think of you, Aiden!
translation: 我对你的看法与怜悯完全相反，Aiden！

source: You're wrong!
translation: 你错了！

source: You’re wrong, Aiden!
translation: 你错了，Aiden！

source: You don’t know how much I’ve looked up to you from the moment I met you!
translation: 你根本不知道，从认识你的那一刻起，我有多么仰慕你！

source: You’re the most patient, resilient, and hardworking person I know… and you put others before yourself.
translation: 你是我认识的人里最有耐心、最坚韧、最勤奋的一个……而且总把别人放在自己前面。

source: But the most special thing about you is how you bring joy to people, always making sure we have a smile on our face.
translation: 但你最特别的地方，是总能给别人带来快乐，确保我们每个人脸上都有笑容。

source: That’s why it honestly breaks my heart to see you like this…
translation: 所以看到你现在这个样子，我真的很心痛……

source: Someone who had the brightest smile, while carrying all this pain in your heart for years, fighting this battle on your own.
translation: 一个笑容如此灿烂的人，却多年来把所有痛苦藏在心里，独自与它抗争。

source: You’ve always hidden this – never letting anyone know what you’ve been through…
translation: 你一直把这些藏起来——从不让任何人知道自己经历了什么……

source: It’s okay to not be okay sometimes, Aiden… You don’t have to bear it alone anymore.
translation: 偶尔状态不好也没关系，Aiden……你不必再独自承受了。

source: Why, Yoshi…?
translation: 为什么，Yoshi……？

source: If it wasn’t pity, then why would you do all this for me, since the beginning…?
translation: 如果不是因为怜悯，那你从一开始为什么要为我做这一切……？

source: It’s because I love you…
translation: 因为我爱你……

source: I fell in love with you from the moment we first met and I saw your smile…
translation: 从我们初次相遇、看到你笑容的那一刻起，我就爱上了你……

source: I loved you more when I saw your strength to endure everything you’ve been through…
translation: 看到你坚强地承受一路经历的一切，我更加爱你……

source: And I love you the most because you gave me a purpose in my dull and gray life…
translation: 而我最爱你，是因为你给我灰暗乏味的人生赋予了意义……

source: …And that is to protect that smile that gives me so much happiness.
translation: ……那就是守护那张带给我无尽幸福的笑脸。

source: This summer flew by really fast, huh, Aiden?
translation: 这个夏天过得真快，对吧，Aiden？

source: Yeah… It feels like it was just yesterday that I met you. And suddenly we’re on the last day of the term…
translation: 是啊……感觉昨天才刚认识你，转眼就到了营期的最后一天……

source: They say time flies when you’re having fun, and I’d say we had tons!
translation: 人们都说快乐的时光总是飞逝，而我们确实经历了无数快乐！

source: You bet. I’m so lucky I got to stay here with you.
translation: 当然。能留在这里陪着你，我真的很幸运。

source: I’d say the same! I’ve never had someone that I’ve gotten as close with as you!
translation: 我也一样！我从没和任何人像与你这样亲近！

source: To think, I just showed up here one day and before I knew it, I was stuck to you like glue, haha!
translation: 想想看，我某天突然来到这里，回过神时已经像胶水一样黏着你了，哈哈！

source: I can’t help it! I just have so much fun hanging out with you!
translation: 我也没办法！和你在一起实在太开心了！

source: You might not believe it, but things wouldn’t have been the same without you.
translation: 你也许不相信，但如果没有你，一切都会完全不同。

source: I should be the one saying that though.
translation: 不过这话应该由我来说。

source: So much has changed for me because of you.
translation: 因为你，我的人生发生了太多变化。

source: Huh? What do you mean, Aiden?
translation: 嗯？什么意思，Aiden？

source: I’m sure I’ve told you before how Dad and I don’t really have much outside of Camp Buddy.
translation: 我想以前告诉过你，我和爸爸在伙伴营之外几乎一无所有。

source: But the truth is, we really don’t have anywhere else to go.
translation: 但事实是，我们真的无处可去。

source: As much as Dad tried to hide it from me, I knew we were in a lot of debt.
translation: 爸爸虽然竭力瞒着我，但我知道我们欠了很多债。

source: He had to work multiple jobs at once, trying to earn enough for us both.
translation: 他不得不同时做几份工作，努力赚够我们两人的生活费。

source: We had to keep moving around, too, until we found Camp Buddy.
translation: 我们还不得不不断搬家，直到找到伙伴营。

source: And that’s when I met you! You were the reason Dad and I got a place to stay for good.
translation: 然后我在那里遇见了你！正因为有你，我和爸爸才终于有了长久安身的地方。

source: We finally didn’t have to worry about all that stuff as much anymore.
translation: 我们终于不用再那么担心那些问题。

source: I didn’t know, Aiden…
translation: 我不知道这些，Aiden……

source: If only I knew more, I could’ve done something to help.
translation: 要是我早知道更多，也许就能做些什么来帮助你。

source: But that’s the thing, Yoshi. Even without knowing, you were able to pull my dad and I out of that situation!
translation: 但重点就在这里，Yoshi。即使毫不知情，你仍然把我和爸爸从那种处境中拉了出来！

source: And for that, I’ll always be thankful…
translation: 为此，我会永远感激你……

source: I-I just never thought, after all this time together, that you were going through something like that…
translation: 我、我只是从没想到，相处了这么久，你竟然一直经历着那样的事……

source: I didn’t want you to feel bad for me, or change the way you see me because of it.
translation: 我不想让你同情我，也不想让你因此改变看待我的方式。

source: And that’s because I really am happy with you, Yoshi.
translation: 因为和你在一起时，我真的很幸福，Yoshi。

source: You didn’t treat me any differently, always going out of your way to spend time with me or to make sure I was never left out.
translation: 你从未区别对待我，总会特意抽出时间陪我，确保我永远不会被冷落。

source: And on top of that, you were always encouraging me to cook, the one thing I knew I loved doing.
translation: 不仅如此，你还一直鼓励我去做自己唯一确定热爱的事——烹饪。

source: You made me realize I could be more than I ever thought I could be.
translation: 你让我意识到，自己可以成为远超想象的人。

source: A-Ah! Sorry, I got carried away!
translation: 啊、啊！抱歉，我说得太投入了！

source: I guess, I was just trying to tell you how grateful I am for everything this summer.
translation: 我想，我只是想告诉你，我有多么感激这个夏天发生的一切。

source: Especially knowing this could be our last night together…
translation: 尤其想到这可能是我们共度的最后一晚……

source: It won’t be, Aiden.
translation: 不会的，Aiden。

source: I’m leaving to study now so I can be a scoutmaster here one day!
translation: 我现在离开是为了学习，将来有一天能回到这里成为童子军长！

source: R-Really, Yoshi?!
translation: 真、真的吗，Yoshi？！

source: Yeah! I know it’ll take a really long time, but once that happens, I’ll be right back here with you!
translation: 没错！我知道这需要很长时间，但等到那一天，我就会回到这里陪你！

source: Then I’ll do everything I can to stay here, and I won’t just wait either… I’ll try to make something out of myself, too…!
translation: 那我也会竭尽全力留在这里，而且不会只是等待……我也会努力做出一番成绩……！

source: Should we seal the deal then?
translation: 那我们来约定吧？

source: Yeah!
translation: 好！

source: Here’s to both of us coming back here together someday!
translation: 为了将来有一天，我们两人一起回到这里！

source: No matter what happens, we’ll stay strong and keep doing our best until that day comes!
translation: 无论发生什么，在那一天到来之前，我们都会保持坚强，继续全力以赴！

source: It’s a promise!
translation: 一言为定！
